sections.label: Invocation
sections.name: अतुलितबलधामं हेमशैलाभदेहं

verses.sa:
शान्तं शाश्वतमप्रमेयमनघं निर्वाणशान्तिप्रदं ।
ब्रह्माशम्भुफणीन्द्रसेव्यमनिशं वेदान्तवेद्यं विभुम् ।
रामाख्यं जगदीश्वरं सुरगुरुं मायामनुष्यं हरिं ।
वन्देऽहं करुणाकरं रघुवरं भूपालचूड़ामणिम् ॥
verses.tr:
śāntaṃ śāśvatamaprameyamanaghaṃ nirvāṇaśāntipradaṃ
brahmāśambhuphaṇīndrasevyamaniśaṃ vedāntavedyaṃ vibhum
rāmākhyaṃ jagadīśvaraṃ suraguruṃ māyāmanuṣyaṃ hariṃ
vande'haṃ karuṇākaraṃ raghuvaraṃ bhūpālacūr̤āmaṇim
verses.head: श्लोक

verses.sa:
नान्या स्पृहा रघुपते हृदयेऽस्मदीये ।
सत्यं वदामि च भवानखिलान्तरात्मा ।
भक्तिं प्रयच्छ रघुपुङ्गव निर्भरां मे ।
कामादिदोषरहितं कुरु मानसं च ॥
verses.tr:
nānyā spṛhā raghupate hṛdaye'smadīye
satyaṃ vadāmi ca bhavānakhilāntarātmā
bhaktiṃ prayaccha raghupuṅgava nirbharāṃ me
kāmādidoṣarahitaṃ kuru mānasaṃ ca

verses.sa:
अतुलितबलधामं हेमशैलाभदेहं ।
दनुजवनकृशानुं ज्ञानिनामग्रगण्यम् ।
सकलगुणनिधानं वानराणामधीशं ।
रघुपतिप्रियभक्तं वातजातं नमामि ॥
verses.tr:
atulitabaladhāmaṃ hemaśailābhadehaṃ
danujavanakṛśānuṃ jñānināmagragaṇyam
sakalaguṇanidhānaṃ vānarāṇāmadhīśaṃ
raghupatipriyabhaktaṃ vātajātaṃ namāmi

trans: I aporg, under his name Rama, the passionless, the eternal, the immeasurable, the sinless; the bestower of the peace of final emancipation; the lord, whom Brahma, Sambhn, and the Serpent-king incessantly worship; the theme of the Vedenta; the sovereign of the universe; the preceptor of the gods; Hari in the delusive form of man: the All-merciful; the princely son of Raghu: the jewel of kings.
O Raghupati, there is no other desire in my soul—I speak the truth and you know all my inmost thoughts— grant me. O Raghu king, a vehement faith, and make my heart clean of lust and every other sin.

I reverence the home of immeasurable strength, with his body resembling a mountain of gold; the fire that consumed the demons as it were the trees of a forest; the first name in the list of the truly wise: the store-house of all good qualities; the monkey chief; Raghupati’s noble messenger, the Son of the Wind.

sections.label: Doha 1
sections.name: हनूमान तेहि परसा कर पुनि कीन्ह प्रनाम

verses.sa:
जामवंत के बचन सुहाए ।
सुनि हनुमंत हृदय अति भाए ॥
verses.tr:
jāmavaṃt ke bacan suhāe
suni hanumaṃt hṛdaya ati bhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तब लगि मोहि परिखेहु तुम्ह भाई ।
सहि दुख कंद मूल फल खाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab lagi mohi parikhehu tumh bhāī
sahi dukh kaṃd mūl phal khāī

verses.sa:
जब लगि आवौं सीतहि देखी ।
होइहि काजु मोहि हरष बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
jab lagi āvauṃ sītahi dekhī
hoihi kāju mohi haraṣ biseṣī

verses.sa:
यह कहि नाइ सबन्हि कहुँ माथा ।
चलेउ हरषि हियँ धरि रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
yah kahi nāi sabanhi kahum̐ māthā
caleu haraṣi hiyam̐ dhari raghunāthā

verses.sa:
सिंधु तीर एक भूधर सुंदर ।
कौतुक कूदि चढ़ेउ ता ऊपर ॥
verses.tr:
siṃdhu tīr ek bhūdhar suṃdar
kautuk kūdi car̤heu tā ūpar

verses.sa:
बार बार रघुबीर सँभारी ।
तरकेउ पवनतनय बल भारी ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār raghubīr sam̐bhārī
tarakeu pavanatanaya bal bhārī

verses.sa:
जेहिं गिरि चरन देइ हनुमंता ।
चलेउ सो गा पाताल तुरंता ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ giri caran dei hanumaṃtā
caleu so gā pātāl turaṃtā

verses.sa:
जिमि अमोघ रघुपति कर बाना ।
एही भाँति चलेउ हनुमाना ॥
verses.tr:
jimi amogh raghupati kar bānā
ehī bhām̐ti caleu hanumānā

verses.sa:
जलनिधि रघुपति दूत बिचारी ।
तैं मैनाक होहि श्रमहारी ॥
verses.tr:
jalanidhi raghupati dūt bicārī
taiṃ maināk hohi śramahārī

verses.sa:
हनूमान तेहि परसा कर पुनि कीन्ह प्रनाम ।
राम काजु कीन्हें बिनु मोहि कहाँ बिश्राम ॥
verses.tr:
hanūmān tehi parasā kar puni kīnh pranām
rām kāju kīnheṃ binu mohi kahām̐ biśrām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing Jambavan speak so cheerfully, Hanuman was greatly rejoiced at heart. “Wait for me here, my friends, however great your discomfort, with only roots, herbs, and fruits for your food, till [ return after seeing Sita; the task is one I am most pleased to undertake.” So saying he bowed his head to them all and went forth with joy, having the image of Raghunath impressed upon his heart. There was a majestic rock by the seashore; he lightly sprung on to the top of it; then, again and again invoking Raghubir, the Son of the Wind leaped with all his might. The mountain on which he had planted his foot sank down immediately into the depths of hell. Like Rama’s own unerring shaft, so sped Hanuman on his way. Ocean had regard for Rama’s envoy and told Mainaeka to ease his toil.
But Hanuman merely touched him with his hand, then bowed and said, ‘I can stop nowhere till I have done Rama's business.’ Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 2
sections.name: राम काजु सबु करिहहु तुम्ह बल बुद्धि निधान

verses.sa:
जात पवनसुत देवन्ह देखा ।
जानैं कहुँ बल बुद्धि बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
jāt pavanasut devanh dekhā
jānaiṃ kahum̐ bal buddhi biseṣā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुरसा नाम अहिन्ह कै माता ।
पठइन्हि आइ कही तेहिं बाता ॥
verses.tr:
surasā nām ahinh kai mātā
paṭhainhi āi kahī tehiṃ bātā

verses.sa:
आजु सुरन्ह मोहि दीन्ह अहारा ।
सुनत बचन कह पवनकुमारा ॥
verses.tr:
āju suranh mohi dīnh ahārā
sunat bacan kah pavanakumārā

verses.sa:
राम काजु करि फिरि मैं आवौं ।
सीता कइ सुधि प्रभुहि सुनावौं ॥
verses.tr:
rām kāju kari phiri maiṃ āvauṃ
sītā kai sudhi prabhuhi sunāvauṃ

verses.sa:
तब तव बदन पैठिहउँ आई ।
सत्य कहउँ मोहि जान दे माई ॥
verses.tr:
tab tav badan paiṭhihaum̐ āī
satya kahaum̐ mohi jān de māī

verses.sa:
कबनेहुँ जतन देइ नहिं जाना ।
ग्रससि न मोहि कहेउ हनुमाना ॥
verses.tr:
kabanehum̐ jatan dei nahiṃ jānā
grasasi na mohi kaheu hanumānā

verses.sa:
जोजन भरि तेहिं बदनु पसारा ।
कपि तनु कीन्ह दुगुन बिस्तारा ॥
verses.tr:
jojan bhari tehiṃ badanu pasārā
kapi tanu kīnh dugun bistārā

verses.sa:
सोरह जोजन मुख तेहिं ठयऊ ।
तुरत पवनसुत बत्तिस भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sorah jojan mukh tehiṃ ṭhayaū
turat pavanasut battis bhayaū

verses.sa:
जस जस सुरसा बदनु बढ़ावा ।
तासु दून कपि रूप देखावा ॥
verses.tr:
jas jas surasā badanu bar̤hāvā
tāsu dūn kapi rūp dekhāvā

verses.sa:
सत जोजन तेहिं आनन कीन्हा ।
अति लघु रूप पवनसुत लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
sat jojan tehiṃ ānan kīnhā
ati laghu rūp pavanasut līnhā

verses.sa:
बदन पइठि पुनि बाहेर आवा ।
मागा बिदा ताहि सिरु नावा ॥
verses.tr:
badan paiṭhi puni bāher āvā
māgā bidā tāhi siru nāvā

verses.sa:
मोहि सुरन्ह जेहि लागि पठावा ।
बुधि बल मरमु तोर मै पावा ॥
verses.tr:
mohi suranh jehi lāgi paṭhāvā
budhi bal maramu tor mai pāvā

verses.sa:
राम काजु सबु करिहहु तुम्ह बल बुद्धि निधान ।
आसिष देह गई सो हरषि चलेउ हनुमान ॥
verses.tr:
rām kāju sabu karihahu tumh bal buddhi nidhān
āsiṣ deh gaī so haraṣi caleu hanumān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The gods saw Hanuman on his way and wished to make special trial of his strength and sagacity, So they sent the mother of the serpeat-race, Surasa by name, who came and cried: ‘To-day the gods have provided me a meal.’ On hearing these words, the Son of the Wind replied: ‘When I have performed Rama’s commission and have come back, and have given my lord the news about Sita, then I will put myself into your mouth: I tell you the truth, mother, only let me go now.” But, however much he tried, she would not let him go, till at last he said: ‘You cannot get me into your mouth.’ She opened her jaws a league wide; the monkey made his body twice that size. Then she stretched her mouth sixteen leagues. Hanuman at once became thirty-two. However much Surase expanded her jaws, the monkey made his frame twice as large again. When she‘had made her mouth a hundred leagues wide, he reduced himself to a very minute form and went into her mouth and came out again: then bowed and asked permission to proceed. “The purpose for which the gods sent me, namely, to make trial of your wisdom and strength, I have now accomplished.
Your wisdom and strength are perfect; you will do all that Rama requires of you.” She then gave him her blessing and departed, and Hanuman went on his way rejoicing.

sections.label: Doha 3
sections.name: पुर रखवारे देखि बहु कपि मन कीन्ह बिचार

verses.sa:
निसिचरि एक सिंधु महुँ रहई ।
करि माया नभु के खग गहई ॥
verses.tr:
nisicari ek siṃdhu mahum̐ rahaī
kari māyā nabhu ke khag gahaī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जीव जंतु जे गगन उड़ाहीं ।
जल बिलोकि तिन्ह कै परिछाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jīv jaṃtu je gagan ur̤āhīṃ
jal biloki tinh kai parichāhīṃ

verses.sa:
गहइ छाहँ सक सो न उड़ाई ।
एहि बिधि सदा गगनचर खाई ॥
verses.tr:
gahai chāham̐ sak so na ur̤āī
ehi bidhi sadā gaganacar khāī

verses.sa:
सोइ छल हनूमान कहँ कीन्हा ।
तासु कपटु कपि तुरतहिं चीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
soi chal hanūmān kaham̐ kīnhā
tāsu kapaṭu kapi turatahiṃ cīnhā

verses.sa:
ताहि मारि मारुतसुत बीरा ।
बारिधि पार गयउ मतिधीरा ॥
verses.tr:
tāhi māri mārutasut bīrā
bāridhi pār gayau matidhīrā

verses.sa:
तहाँ जाइ देखी बन सोभा ।
गुंजत चंचरीक मधु लोभा ॥
verses.tr:
tahām̐ jāi dekhī ban sobhā
guṃjat caṃcarīk madhu lobhā

verses.sa:
नाना तरु फल फूल सुहाए ।
खग मृग बृंद देखि मन भाए ॥
verses.tr:
nānā taru phal phūl suhāe
khag mṛg bṛṃd dekhi man bhāe

verses.sa:
सैल बिसाल देखि एक आगें ।
ता पर धाइ चढेउ भय त्यागें ॥
verses.tr:
sail bisāl dekhi ek āgeṃ
tā par dhāi caḍheu bhaya tyāgeṃ

verses.sa:
उमा न कछु कपि कै अधिकाई ।
प्रभु प्रताप जो कालहि खाई ॥
verses.tr:
umā na kachu kapi kai adhikāī
prabhu pratāp jo kālahi khāī

verses.sa:
गिरि पर चढि लंका तेहिं देखी ।
कहि न जाइ अति दुर्ग बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
giri par caḍhi laṃkā tehiṃ dekhī
kahi na jāi ati durg biseṣī

verses.sa:
अति उतंग जलनिधि चहु पासा ।
कनक कोट कर परम प्रकासा ॥
verses.tr:
ati utaṃg jalanidhi cahu pāsā
kanak koṭ kar param prakāsā

verses.sa:
कनक कोट बिचित्र मनि कृत सुंदरायतना घना ।
चउहट्ट हट्ट सुबट्ट बीथीं चारु पुर बहु बिधि बना ॥
verses.tr:
kanak koṭ bicitr mani kṛt suṃdarāyatanā ghanā
cauhaṭṭ haṭṭ subaṭṭ bīthīṃ cāru pur bahu bidhi banā
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: गज बाजि खच्चर निकर पदचर रथ बरूथिन्ह को गनै ॥
verses.tr: gaj bāji khaccar nikar padacar rath barūthinh ko ganai

verses.sa: बहुरूप निसिचर जूथ अतिबल सेन बरनत नहिं बनै ॥
verses.tr: bahurūp nisicar jūth atibal sen baranat nahiṃ banai

verses.sa:
बन बाग उपबन बाटिका सर कूप बापीं सोहहीं ।
नर नाग सुर गंधर्ब कन्या रूप मुनि मन मोहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ban bāg upaban bāṭikā sar kūp bāpīṃ sohahīṃ
nar nāg sur gaṃdharb kanyā rūp muni man mohahīṃ

verses.sa:
कहुँ माल देह बिसाल सैल समान अतिबल गर्जहीं ।
नाना अखारेन्ह भिरहिं बहु बिधि एक एकन्ह तर्जहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahum̐ māl deh bisāl sail samān atibal garjahīṃ
nānā akhārenh bhirahiṃ bahu bidhi ek ekanh tarjahīṃ

verses.sa:
करि जतन भट कोटिन्ह बिकट तन नगर चहुँ दिसि रच्छहीं ।
कहुँ महिष मानषु धेनु खर अज खल निसाचर भच्छहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kari jatan bhaṭ koṭinh bikaṭ tan nagar cahum̐ disi racchahīṃ
kahum̐ mahiṣ mānaṣu dhenu khar aj khal nisācar bhacchahīṃ

verses.sa:
एहि लागि तुलसीदास इन्ह की कथा कछु एक है कही ।
रघुबीर सर तीरथ सरीरन्हि त्यागि गति पैहहिं सही ॥
verses.tr:
ehi lāgi tulasīdās inh kī kathā kachu ek hai kahī
raghubīr sar tīrath sarīranhi tyāgi gati paihahiṃ sahī

verses.sa:
पुर रखवारे देखि बहु कपि मन कीन्ह बिचार ।
अति लघु रूप धरौं निसि नगर करौं पइसार ॥
verses.tr:
pur rakhavāre dekhi bahu kapi man kīnh bicār
ati laghu rūp dharauṃ nisi nagar karauṃ paisār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: A female demon dwelt in the ocean, who by magic caught the birds of the air. All living creatures that fly in the air as they look down upon the water cast a shadow upon it; and she was able to catch the shadow, so that they could not fly away; and in this manner she always had birds to eat. She played this same trick on Hanuman; but the monkey at once saw through her craft and slew her, hero as he was, and all undismayed crossed over to the opposite shore. Arriving there, he marked the beauty of the wood, with the bees buzzing in their search for honey, the diverse trees all resplendent with simultaneous flower and fruit, and multitudes of birds and deer delightful to behold. Seeing ‘huge rock further on, he fearlessly sprang on the top of it. But, Uma, this was not at all the monkey’s own strength, but the gift of the Lord, who devours even Death himself. Mounted on the height, he surveyed Lanka a magnificent fortress that defies description, with the deep sea on all four sides around its golden walls of dazzling splendour. Chhand 1.

Its golden walls studded with all kinds of jewels, a marvellously beautiful sight, with market-places, bazdrs, quays, and streets, and all the other accessories of a fine city. Who could count the multitude of elephants, horses and mules, the crowds of footmen and chariots, and the troops of demons of every shape, a formidable host beyond all description. The woods, gardens, groves, and pastures, the ponds, wells and tanks were all superb: and the soul of a saint would be ravished at the sight of the fair daughters, both of men and Nagas, of gods and Gandharvas. Here wrestlers, of monstrous stature like mountains, were thundering with mighty voice and grappling with one another in the different courts, with shouts of mutual defiance. Thousands. of warriors of huge bulk were sedulously guarding the city on all four sides; elsewhere horrid demons were banqueting in the form of buffaloes, men, oxen, asses and goats. Tulsi Das for this reason gives them a few words of mention, because they lost their life by Rama's hallowed shafts and thus became assured of entrance into heaven. j
Seeing thenumber of the city guards the monkey thought to himself, ‘I must make myself very small and slip into the town by night.’

sections.label: Doha 4
sections.name: तात स्वर्ग अपबर्ग सुख धरिअ तुला एक अंग

verses.sa:
मसक समान रूप कपि धरी ।
लंकहि चलेउ सुमिरि नरहरी ॥
verses.tr:
masak samān rūp kapi dharī
laṃkahi caleu sumiri naraharī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाम लंकिनी एक निसिचरी ।
सो कह चलेसि मोहि निंदरी ॥
verses.tr:
nām laṃkinī ek nisicarī
so kah calesi mohi niṃdarī

verses.sa:
जानेहि नहीं मरमु सठ मोरा ।
मोर अहार जहाँ लगि चोरा ॥
verses.tr:
jānehi nahīṃ maramu saṭh morā
mor ahār jahām̐ lagi corā

verses.sa:
मुठिका एक महा कपि हनी ।
रुधिर बमत धरनीं ढनमनी ॥
verses.tr:
muṭhikā ek mahā kapi hanī
rudhir bamat dharanīṃ ḍhanamanī

verses.sa:
पुनि संभारि उठि सो लंका ।
जोरि पानि कर बिनय संसका ॥
verses.tr:
puni saṃbhāri uṭhi so laṃkā
jori pāni kar binaya saṃsakā

verses.sa:
जब रावनहि ब्रह्म बर दीन्हा ।
चलत बिरंचि कहा मोहि चीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jab rāvanahi brahm bar dīnhā
calat biraṃci kahā mohi cīnhā

verses.sa:
बिकल होसि तैं कपि कें मारे ।
तब जानेसु निसिचर संघारे ॥
verses.tr:
bikal hosi taiṃ kapi keṃ māre
tab jānesu nisicar saṃghāre

verses.sa:
तात मोर अति पुन्य बहूता ।
देखेउँ नयन राम कर दूता ॥
verses.tr:
tāt mor ati punya bahūtā
dekheum̐ nayan rām kar dūtā

verses.sa:
तात स्वर्ग अपबर्ग सुख धरिअ तुला एक अंग ।
तूल न ताहि सकल मिलि जो सुख लव सतसंग ॥
verses.tr:
tāt svarg apabarg sukh dharia tulā ek aṃg
tūl na tāhi sakal mili jo sukh lav satasaṃg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Thereupon he assumed the formiof a gnat and entered

Lanka after invoking Vishnu. The female demon, by name Lankini, accosted him: ‘How dare you come here in contempt of me Fool, do you not know my practice, that every thief in Lanka becomes my prey?” The monkey struck her one such a blow with his fist that she fell to the ground vomiting blood. Recovering herself again, she stood up and with clasped hands made this confident petition: ‘“When Brahm granted Ravan’s prayer, the Creator gave me a sign before he left, ‘When worsted by a monkey, know then that it is all over with demons.’ My meritorious deeds, my son, must have been very many that I have been rewarded with the sight of Rama’s messenger.

In one scale of the balance put the bliss of heaven and the final emancipation of the soul from the body, but it will be altogether outweighed by a fraction of the joy that results from communion with the saints.

sections.label: Doha 5
sections.name: रामायुध अंकित गृह सोभा बरनि न जाइ

verses.sa:
प्रबिसि नगर कीजे सब काजा ।
हृदयँ राखि कौसलपुर राजा ॥
verses.tr:
prabisi nagar kīje sab kājā
hṛdayam̐ rākhi kausalapur rājā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गरल सुधा रिपु करहिं मिताई ।
गोपद सिंधु अनल सितलाई ॥
verses.tr:
garal sudhā ripu karahiṃ mitāī
gopad siṃdhu anal sitalāī

verses.sa:
गरुड़ सुमेरु रेनू सम ताही ।
राम कृपा करि चितवा जाही ॥
verses.tr:
garur̤ sumeru renū sam tāhī
rām kṛpā kari citavā jāhī

verses.sa:
अति लघु रूप धरेउ हनुमाना ।
पैठा नगर सुमिरि भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
ati laghu rūp dhareu hanumānā
paiṭhā nagar sumiri bhagavānā

verses.sa:
मंदिर मंदिर प्रति करि सोधा ।
देखे जहँ तहँ अगनित जोधा ॥
verses.tr:
maṃdir maṃdir prati kari sodhā
dekhe jaham̐ taham̐ aganit jodhā

verses.sa:
गयउ दसानन मंदिर माहीं ।
अति बिचित्र कहि जात सो नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
gayau dasānan maṃdir māhīṃ
ati bicitr kahi jāt so nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सयन किए देखा कपि तेही ।
मंदिर महुँ न दीखि बैदेही ॥
verses.tr:
sayan kie dekhā kapi tehī
maṃdir mahum̐ na dīkhi baidehī

verses.sa:
भवन एक पुनि दीख सुहावा ।
हरि मंदिर तहँ भिन्न बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
bhavan ek puni dīkh suhāvā
hari maṃdir taham̐ bhinn banāvā

verses.sa:
रामायुध अंकित गृह सोभा बरनि न जाइ ।
नव तुलसिका बृंद तहँ देखि हरषि कपिराइ ॥
verses.tr:
rāmāyudh aṃkit gṛh sobhā barani na jāi
nav tulasikā bṛṃd taham̐ dekhi haraṣi kapirāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Enter the city and accomplish your task, over mindful at heart of the lord of Kosala. Deadly poison becomes as ambrosia, foes turn friends, ocean shrinks to a mere puddle, fire gives out cold, and huge Sumeru is of no more account than a grain of sand for him whom Rama deigns to regard with favour.’ In the tiny form that he had assumed, HanumAn entered the city with a prayer to God. Carefully inspecting every separate palace, he found everywhere warriors innumerable. When he had come to Ravan’s court, its magnificence was past all telling. The monkey saw him in bedasleep, but no trace of Sita in the room. He then noticed another splendid building, with a temple of Hari standing apart, its walls brilliantly illuminated with Rama's name, too beautiful to describe, it fascinated every beholder.
The beauty of the chamber emblazoned with Rama’s insignia was indescribable. At the sight of some fresh springs of tulsi, the monkey chief was enraptured.

sections.label: Doha 6
sections.name: तब हनुमंत कही सब राम कथा निज नाम

verses.sa:
लंका निसिचर निकर निवासा ।
इहाँ कहाँ सज्जन कर बासा ॥
verses.tr:
laṃkā nisicar nikar nivāsā
ihām̐ kahām̐ sajjan kar bāsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मन महुँ तरक करै कपि लागा ।
तेहीं समय बिभीषनु जागा ॥
verses.tr:
man mahum̐ tarak karai kapi lāgā
tehīṃ samaya bibhīṣanu jāgā

verses.sa:
राम राम तेहिं सुमिरन कीन्हा ।
हृदयँ हरष कपि सज्जन चीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
rām rām tehiṃ sumiran kīnhā
hṛdayam̐ haraṣ kapi sajjan cīnhā

verses.sa:
एहि सन हठि करिहउँ पहिचानी ।
साधु ते होइ न कारज हानी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi san haṭhi karihaum̐ pahicānī
sādhu te hoi na kāraj hānī

verses.sa:
बिप्र रुप धरि बचन सुनाए ।
सुनत बिभीषण उठि तहँ आए ॥
verses.tr:
bipr rup dhari bacan sunāe
sunat bibhīṣaṇ uṭhi taham̐ āe

verses.sa:
करि प्रनाम पूँछी कुसलाई ।
बिप्र कहहु निज कथा बुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranām pūm̐chī kusalāī
bipr kahahu nij kathā bujhāī

verses.sa:
की तुम्ह हरि दासन्ह महँ कोई ।
मोरें हृदय प्रीति अति होई ॥
verses.tr:
kī tumh hari dāsanh maham̐ koī
moreṃ hṛdaya prīti ati hoī

verses.sa:
की तुम्ह रामु दीन अनुरागी ।
आयहु मोहि करन बड़भागी ॥
verses.tr:
kī tumh rāmu dīn anurāgī
āyahu mohi karan bar̤abhāgī

verses.sa:
तब हनुमंत कही सब राम कथा निज नाम ।
सुनत जुगल तन पुलक मन मगन सुमिरि गुन ग्राम ॥
verses.tr:
tab hanumaṃt kahī sab rām kathā nij nām
sunat jugal tan pulak man magan sumiri gun grām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: _ “Lanka is the abode of a gang of demons, how can the pious have any home here?” While the monkey was thus reasoning within himself, Vibhishan awoke and at once began to repeat Rama’s name io prayer. The monkey was delighted to find a true believer. ‘Shall I at once make myself known tohim? A good man will never spoil any undertaking.” Assuming the form of a Brahman, he raised his voice in speech. Assoon as Vibhishan heard him, he rose to meet him, and bowing low, asked after his welfare, saying, “Tell me, reverend Sir, who you may be; ifa servant of Hari, you have my hearty affection; if a loving follower of Rama your visit isa great honour for me.”’
Hanuman then told him Rama's whole history and his own name. At the recital and the recollection of his infinite virtues, both quivered «all over the body, while their soul was drowned in joy.

sections.label: Doha 7
sections.name: अस मैं अधम सखा सुनु मोहू पर रघुबीर

verses.sa:
सुनहु पवनसुत रहनि हमारी ।
जिमि दसनन्हि महुँ जीभ बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu pavanasut rahani hamārī
jimi dasananhi mahum̐ jībh bicārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तात कबहुँ मोहि जानि अनाथा ।
करिहहिं कृपा भानुकुल नाथा ॥
verses.tr:
tāt kabahum̐ mohi jāni anāthā
karihahiṃ kṛpā bhānukul nāthā

verses.sa:
तामस तनु कछु साधन नाहीं ।
प्रीति न पद सरोज मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tāmas tanu kachu sādhan nāhīṃ
prīti na pad saroj man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
अब मोहि भा भरोस हनुमंता ।
बिनु हरिकृपा मिलहिं नहिं संता ॥
verses.tr:
ab mohi bhā bharos hanumaṃtā
binu harikṛpā milahiṃ nahiṃ saṃtā

verses.sa:
जौ रघुबीर अनुग्रह कीन्हा ।
तौ तुम्ह मोहि दरसु हठि दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jau raghubīr anugrah kīnhā
tau tumh mohi darasu haṭhi dīnhā

verses.sa:
सुनहु बिभीषन प्रभु कै रीती ।
करहिं सदा सेवक पर प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu bibhīṣan prabhu kai rītī
karahiṃ sadā sevak par prītī

verses.sa:
कहहु कवन मैं परम कुलीना ।
कपि चंचल सबहीं बिधि हीना ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu kavan maiṃ param kulīnā
kapi caṃcal sabahīṃ bidhi hīnā

verses.sa:
प्रात लेइ जो नाम हमारा ।
तेहि दिन ताहि न मिलै अहारा ॥
verses.tr:
prāt lei jo nām hamārā
tehi din tāhi na milai ahārā

verses.sa:
अस मैं अधम सखा सुनु मोहू पर रघुबीर ।
कीन्ही कृपा सुमिरि गुन भरे बिलोचन नीर ॥
verses.tr:
as maiṃ adham sakhā sunu mohū par raghubīr
kīnhī kṛpā sumiri gun bhare bilocan nīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Hearken, Son of the Wind; my condition here is like that of the poor tongue between the teeth. Yet do not suppose, Father, that I am friendless: the Lord of the Solar race will show me favour. The sinful body is of no avail, if the soul has no love for his lotus feet. But now, Hanu-m&n, I have gained confidence: for it is only by Hari’s favour that one meets a good man, and it is the result of his kindness that you have so readily revealed yourself to me.” ‘Listen, Vibhishan, to my experience of the Lord: he is ever affectionate to his servants. Say whoam I and of what noble descent;a wanton monkey, of no merit whatever, a creature the mention of whose name in the early morning makes a man go fasting for the whole day.
So mean am I; yet hearken, friend; Raghubir has shown favour even to me.” His eyes filled with tears as he recalled his perfection.

sections.label: Doha 8
sections.name: निज पद नयन दिएँ मन राम पद कमल लीन

verses.sa:
जानतहूँ अस स्वामि बिसारी ।
फिरहिं ते काहे न होहिं दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
jānatahūm̐ as svāmi bisārī
phirahiṃ te kāhe na hohiṃ dukhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि कहत राम गुन ग्रामा ।
पावा अनिर्बाच्य बिश्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi kahat rām gun grāmā
pāvā anirbācya biśrāmā

verses.sa:
पुनि सब कथा बिभीषन कही ।
जेहि बिधि जनकसुता तहँ रही ॥
verses.tr:
puni sab kathā bibhīṣan kahī
jehi bidhi janakasutā taham̐ rahī

verses.sa:
तब हनुमंत कहा सुनु भ्राता ।
देखी चहउँ जानकी माता ॥
verses.tr:
tab hanumaṃt kahā sunu bhrātā
dekhī cahaum̐ jānakī mātā

verses.sa:
जुगुति बिभीषन सकल सुनाई ।
चलेउ पवनसुत बिदा कराई ॥
verses.tr:
juguti bibhīṣan sakal sunāī
caleu pavanasut bidā karāī

verses.sa:
करि सोइ रूप गयउ पुनि तहवाँ ।
बन असोक सीता रह जहवाँ ॥
verses.tr:
kari soi rūp gayau puni tahavām̐
ban asok sītā rah jahavām̐

verses.sa:
देखि मनहि महुँ कीन्ह प्रनामा ।
बैठेहिं बीति जात निसि जामा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi manahi mahum̐ kīnh pranāmā
baiṭhehiṃ bīti jāt nisi jāmā

verses.sa:
कृस तन सीस जटा एक बेनी ।
जपति हृदयँ रघुपति गुन श्रेनी ॥
verses.tr:
kṛs tan sīs jaṭā ek benī
japati hṛdayam̐ raghupati gun śrenī

verses.sa:
निज पद नयन दिएँ मन राम पद कमल लीन ।
परम दुखी भा पवनसुत देखि जानकी दीन ॥
verses.tr:
nij pad nayan diem̐ man rām pad kamal līn
param dukhī bhā pavanasut dekhi jānakī dīn
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘“‘ T know of a truth that any who turns aside in forget-fulness of such a lord may well be miserable.” As he thus discoursed on Rama’s excellences, he felt an unspeakable calm. Vibhishan then told him of all that had been going on and of Sita’s mode of Jifs, till Hanuman cried: ‘Hearken, brother; I would fain see the august Sita.” Vibhishan explained to him the whole mode of procedure, and the Son of the Wind then took his leave and proceeded on his way. Assuming the same form as at first he went to the Asoka grove, where Sita dwelt, As soou us he saw her, mentally prostrated himself in her presence. She had spent the first watch of the night sitting up, haggard in appearance, her hair knotted in a single braid on her head, repeating to herself the list of Raghupati’s perfections.
Her eyes fastened on her own feet, but with her soul absorbed in the contemplation of the feet of her lord. Hanuman was mightily distrest to see her so sad.

sections.label: Doha 9
sections.name: आपुहि सुनि खद्योत सम रामहि भानु समान

verses.sa:
तरु पल्लव महुँ रहा लुकाई ।
करइ बिचार करौं का भाई ॥
verses.tr:
taru pallav mahum̐ rahā lukāī
karai bicār karauṃ kā bhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर रावनु तहँ आवा ।
संग नारि बहु किएँ बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar rāvanu taham̐ āvā
saṃg nāri bahu kiem̐ banāvā

verses.sa:
बहु बिधि खल सीतहि समुझावा ।
साम दान भय भेद देखावा ॥
verses.tr:
bahu bidhi khal sītahi samujhāvā
sām dān bhaya bhed dekhāvā

verses.sa:
कह रावनु सुनु सुमुखि सयानी ।
मंदोदरी आदि सब रानी ॥
verses.tr:
kah rāvanu sunu sumukhi sayānī
maṃdodarī ādi sab rānī

verses.sa:
तव अनुचरीं करउँ पन मोरा ।
एक बार बिलोकु मम ओरा ॥
verses.tr:
tav anucarīṃ karaum̐ pan morā
ek bār biloku mam orā

verses.sa:
तृन धरि ओट कहति बैदेही ।
सुमिरि अवधपति परम सनेही ॥
verses.tr:
tṛn dhari oṭ kahati baidehī
sumiri avadhapati param sanehī

verses.sa:
सुनु दसमुख खद्योत प्रकासा ।
कबहुँ कि नलिनी करइ बिकासा ॥
verses.tr:
sunu dasamukh khadyot prakāsā
kabahum̐ ki nalinī karai bikāsā

verses.sa:
अस मन समुझु कहति जानकी ।
खल सुधि नहिं रघुबीर बान की ॥
verses.tr:
as man samujhu kahati jānakī
khal sudhi nahiṃ raghubīr bān kī

verses.sa:
सठ सूने हरि आनेहि मोहि ।
अधम निलज्ज लाज नहिं तोही ॥
verses.tr:
saṭh sūne hari ānehi mohi
adham nilajj lāj nahiṃ tohī

verses.sa:
आपुहि सुनि खद्योत सम रामहि भानु समान ।
परुष बचन सुनि काढ़ि असि बोला अति खिसिआन ॥
verses.tr:
āpuhi suni khadyot sam rāmahi bhānu samān
paruṣ bacan suni kār̤hi asi bolā ati khisiān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Concealing himself behind the branches ofa tree, he mused with himself; ‘Come, sir, what oughtI to do?” At that very moment Ravan drew near, witha troop of women in various attire. The wretch tried in every way to talk Sita over, by blandishments, bribes, threats and misrepresentations. ‘Hearken, fair dame,” he cried, ‘“T will make Mandodari and all my other queens your handmaids, I swear it, if you only give me one look.” Sita plucked a blade of grass, and with averted face, fondly remembering her own dear lord, replied: ‘Hearken, Ravan: will the lotus expand at the light of a glow-worm? Ponder this at heart,” cried Janaki: ‘Wretch, have you no fear of Rama’s shafts Hven though absent, Hari will rescue me. Shameless monster, have you no shame
I tell you, you are but a glow-worm, while the very sun is only an image of Rama.” On hearing this bold speech he drew his sword and cried in the utmost fury:

sections.label: Doha 10
sections.name: भवन गयउ दसकंधर इहाँ पिसाचिनि बृंद

verses.sa:
सीता तैं मम कृत अपमाना ।
कटिहउँ तव सिर कठिन कृपाना ॥
verses.tr:
sītā taiṃ mam kṛt apamānā
kaṭihaum̐ tav sir kaṭhin kṛpānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाहिं त सपदि मानु मम बानी ।
सुमुखि होति न त जीवन हानी ॥
verses.tr:
nāhiṃ ta sapadi mānu mam bānī
sumukhi hoti na ta jīvan hānī

verses.sa:
स्याम सरोज दाम सम सुंदर ।
प्रभु भुज करि कर सम दसकंधर ॥
verses.tr:
syām saroj dām sam suṃdar
prabhu bhuj kari kar sam dasakaṃdhar

verses.sa:
सो भुज कंठ कि तव असि घोरा ।
सुनु सठ अस प्रवान पन मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
so bhuj kaṃṭh ki tav asi ghorā
sunu saṭh as pravān pan morā

verses.sa:
चंद्रहास हरु मम परितापं ।
रघुपति बिरह अनल संजातं ॥
verses.tr:
caṃdrahās haru mam paritāpaṃ
raghupati birah anal saṃjātaṃ

verses.sa:
सीतल निसित बहसि बर धारा ।
कह सीता हरु मम दुख भारा ॥
verses.tr:
sītal nisit bahasi bar dhārā
kah sītā haru mam dukh bhārā

verses.sa:
सुनत बचन पुनि मारन धावा ।
मयतनयाँ कहि नीति बुझावा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bacan puni māran dhāvā
mayatanayām̐ kahi nīti bujhāvā

verses.sa:
कहेसि सकल निसिचरिन्ह बोलाई ।
सीतहि बहु बिधि त्रासहु जाई ॥

मास दिवस महुँ कहा न माना ।

भवन गयउ दसकंधर इहाँ पिसाचिनि बृंद ।

sections.label: Doha 11

verses.tr:
trijaṭā nām rācchasī ekā
rām caran rati nipun bibekā
verses.head: चौपाई

सबन्हौ बोलि सुनाएसि सपना ।
सीतहि सेइ करहु हित अपना ॥
verses.tr:
sabanhau boli sunāesi sapanā
sītahi sei karahu hit apanā

सपनें बानर लंका जारी ।
जातुधान सेना सब मारी ॥
verses.tr:
sapaneṃ bānar laṃkā jārī
jātudhān senā sab mārī

खर आरूढ़ नगन दससीसा ।
मुंडित सिर खंडित भुज बीसा ॥
verses.tr:
khar ārūr̤h nagan dasasīsā
muṃḍit sir khaṃḍit bhuj bīsā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सो दच्छिन दिसि जाई ।
लंका मनहुँ बिभीषन पाई ॥

नगर फिरी रघुबीर दोहाई ।

verses.tr:
nagar phirī raghubīr dohāī

यह सपना में कहउँ पुकारी ।
होइहि सत्य गएँ दिन चारी ॥
verses.tr:
yah sapanā meṃ kahaum̐ pukārī
hoihi satya gaem̐ din cārī

तासु बचन सुनि ते सब डरीं ।
जनकसुता के चरनन्हि परीं ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu bacan suni te sab ḍarīṃ
janakasutā ke carananhi parīṃ

जहँ तहँ गईं सकल तब सीता कर मन सोच ।
मास दिवस बीतें मोहि मारिहि निसिचर पोच ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ gaīṃ sakal tab sītā kar man soc

sections.label: Doha 12
sections.name: कपि करि हृदयँ बिचार दीन्हि मुद्रिका डारी तब

verses.sa:
त्रिजटा सन बोली कर जोरी ।
मातु बिपति संगिनि तैं मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
trijaṭā san bolī kar jorī
mātu bipati saṃgini taiṃ morī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तजौं देह करु बेगि उपाई ।
दुसहु बिरहु अब नहिं सहि जाई ॥
verses.tr:
tajauṃ deh karu begi upāī
dusahu birahu ab nahiṃ sahi jāī

verses.sa:
आनि काठ रचु चिता बनाई ।
मातु अनल पुनि देहि लगाई ॥
verses.tr:
āni kāṭh racu citā banāī
mātu anal puni dehi lagāī

सत्य करहि मम प्रीति सयानी ।
सुनै को श्रवन सूल सम बानी ॥
verses.tr:
satya karahi mam prīti sayānī
sunai ko śravan sūl sam bānī

सुनत बचन पद गहि समुझाएसि ।
प्रभु प्रताप बल सुजसु सुनाएसि ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bacan pad gahi samujhāesi
prabhu pratāp bal sujasu sunāesi

निसि न अनल मिल सुनु सुकुमारी ।
अस कहि सो निज भवन सिधारी ॥
verses.tr:
nisi na anal mil sunu sukumārī
as kahi so nij bhavan sidhārī

verses.sa:
कह सीता बिधि भा प्रतिकूला ।
मिलहि न पावक मिटिहि न सूला ॥
verses.tr:
kah sītā bidhi bhā pratikūlā
milahi na pāvak miṭihi na sūlā

देखिअत प्रगट गगन अंगारा ।

verses.tr:
dekhiat pragaṭ gagan aṃgārā

verses.tr:

mānahum̐ mohi jāni hatabhāgī

verses.tr:
sunahi binaya mam biṭap asokā
satya nām karu haru mam sokā

verses.tr:

कपि करि हृदयँ बिचार दीन्हि मुद्रिका डारी तब ।
जनु असोक अंगार दीन्हि हरषि उठि कर गहेउ ॥
verses.tr:
kapi kari hṛdayam̐ bicār dīnhi mudrikā ḍārī tab
janu asok aṃgār dīnhi haraṣi uṭhi kar gaheu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: monster will slay me.’

With clasped hands she cried to Trijite: “‘ Mother, you are my helper in distress; quickly devise some plan that I may be rid of life, for this intolerable bereavement 13 Do longer to be endured. Bring wood and erect my funeral pyre and then set fire to it. My affection, reverend dame, will thus be attested.” Who could bear to listen to such an agonizing cry When she heard her speech she clasped her feet and would fain comfort her by reciting the majesty and might and glory of her lord. “Hearken, fair lady; there is no fire to be had at night;” and so saying she went away home, Sita exclaimed: ‘Heaven is unkind; without fire my pain cannot be cured. I see the heaven all bright with sparks, but not a single star drops to the earth. The moon is all ablaze, but no fire comes from it, as if it knew what a poor wretch Iam. Ye Asoka trees, that hear my prayer, answer to your name and rid me of my pain; and you flame-coloured opening buds, supply me with fire to consume my body.” A single moment seemed like an age to the monkey, as he beheld Sita thus piteously lamenting her bereavement.
After taking thought within himself he threw down the signet ring, as though a spark had fallen from the Asoka. She started up with joy and clasped it in her hand.

sections.label: Doha 13
sections.name: कपि के बचन सप्रेम सुनि उपजा मन बिस्वास

verses.sa:
तब देखी मुद्रिका मनोहर ।
राम नाम अंकित अति सुंदर ॥
verses.tr:

rām nām aṃkit ati suṃdar
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चकित चितव मुदरी पहिचानी ।
हरष बिषाद हृदयँ अकुलानी ॥
verses.tr:
cakit citav mudarī pahicānī
haraṣ biṣād hṛdayam̐ akulānī

जीति को सकइ अजय रघुराई ।
माया तें असि रचि नहिं जाई ॥

सीता मन बिचार कर नाना ।
मधुर बचन बोलेउ हनुमाना ॥

lāgīṃ sunaiṃ śravan man lāī

verses.tr:
yah mudrikā mātu maiṃ ānī
dīnhi rām tumh kaham̐ sahidānī

verses.sa:
नर बानरहि संग कहु कैसें ।
कहि कथा भइ संगति जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
nar bānarahi saṃg kahu kaiseṃ

verses.tr: kapi ke bacan saprem suni upajā man bisvās

As Sita listened, her grief took flight. Intently she hearkened with all her soul as well as her ears, while he related the whole story from the very beginning. * The tale you tell is so grateful to my ears; why do you not show yourself, friend? sajal nayan pulakāvali bār̤hī

बूड़त बिरह जलधि हनुमाना ।
भयउ तात मों कहुँ जलजाना ॥
verses.tr:
būr̤at birah jaladhi hanumānā
bhayau tāt moṃ kahum̐ jalajānā

अब कहु कुसल जाउँ बलिहारी ।

verses.tr:

verses.tr:
komalacit kṛpāl raghurāī
kapi kehi hetu dharī niṭhurāī

सहज बानि सेवक सुख दायक ।
कबहुँक सुरति करत रघुनायक ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj bāni sevak sukh dāyak

dekhi param birahākul sītā

जनि जननी मानहु जियँ ऊना ।

trans: On perceiving him to be one of Hari’s worshippers, she felt an intense affection for him; her eyes filled with tears, her body quivered with emotion. “0 Hanuman, I was sinking in the ocean of bereavement, but in you, my friend, I have found a ship. Tell me now of their welfare, 1 adjare you; bow is the blessed Khareri and how is his brother? Raghurdi is tender-hearted and merciful, why, O monkey, should her affect such cruelty ¢ The mere sound of his voice is a delight to his servant. Does he ever deign to remember me Will my eyes, friend, be ever gladdened by the sight of his dark and delicate body?” Words failed, her eyes swam with tears. ‘Alas my lord has entirely forgotten me.” Seeing Sita thus distracted by the bereavement, the monkey replied in gentle and respectful tones: ‘Lady, your lord and his brother are both well, save that the Allmerciful sorrows for your sorrow. suni mam bacan tajahu kadarāī

verses.sa:
निसिचर निकर पतंग सम रघुपति बान कृसानु ।
जननी हृदयँ धीर धरु जरे निसाचर जानु ॥
verses.tr:
nisicar nikar pataṃg sam raghupati bān kṛsānu
jananī hṛdayam̐ dhīr dharu jare nisācar jānu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then he proceeded to tell her of Ltama’s forlorn condition ‘“Every thing—says he—is changed into its opposite. The fresh buds upon the trees burn like fire; night seems as the night of death, and the moon scorches like the sun. A bed of lotuses seems a prickly brake, and the rain-clouds drop boiling oil. The trees only add to my pain, and the softest and most fragrant breeze is like the breath of a serpent. Nothing relieves my torture, and to whom can I declare it? for there is no one who will understand. The essence of such love as yours and mine, my beloved, only my own soul can comprehend, and this my soul is always with you. Know suob tozbe the profundity of my love.” As the Videhan princess listened to Rama's message, she became so absorbed in love as to have no thought for herself. Said the monkey: “Lady, compose yourself, remembering that Rama is a benefactor to all who serve him. Reflect upon his might and, as you listen to my speech, discard all anxiety.
The demon crew are like moths and Raghupati’s arrows as a fame; be stout of heart, madam, and rest assured that they will be consumed.

sections.label: Doha 16
sections.name: सुनु माता साखामृग नहिं बल बुद्धि बिसाल

verses.sa:
जौं रघुबीर होति सुधि पाई ।
करते नहिं बिलंबु रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ raghubīr hoti sudhi pāī
karate nahiṃ bilaṃbu raghurāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रामबान रबि उएँ जानकी ।
तम बरूथ कहँ जातुधान की ॥
verses.tr:
rāmabān rabi uem̐ jānakī
tam barūth kaham̐ jātudhān kī

verses.sa:
अबहिं मातु मैं जाउँ लवाई ।
प्रभु आयसु नहिं राम दोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
abahiṃ mātu maiṃ jāum̐ lavāī
prabhu āyasu nahiṃ rām dohāī

verses.sa:
कछुक दिवस जननी धरु धीरा ।
कपिन्ह सहित अइहहिं रघुबीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kachuk divas jananī dharu dhīrā
kapinh sahit aihahiṃ raghubīrā

verses.sa:
निसिचर मारि तोहि लै जैहहिं ।
तिहुँ पुर नारदादि जसु गैहहिं ॥
verses.tr:
nisicar māri tohi lai jaihahiṃ
tihum̐ pur nāradādi jasu gaihahiṃ

verses.sa:
हैं सुत कपि सब तुम्हहि समाना ।
जातुधान अति भट बलवाना ॥
verses.tr:
haiṃ sut kapi sab tumhahi samānā
jātudhān ati bhaṭ balavānā

verses.sa:
मोरें हृदय परम संदेहा ।
सुनि कपि प्रगट कीन्ह निज देहा ॥
verses.tr:
moreṃ hṛdaya param saṃdehā
suni kapi pragaṭ kīnh nij dehā

verses.sa:
कनक भूधराकार सरीरा ।
समर भयंकर अतिबल बीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kanak bhūdharākār sarīrā
samar bhayaṃkar atibal bīrā

verses.sa:
सीता मन भरोस तब भयऊ ।
पुनि लघु रूप पवनसुत लयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sītā man bharos tab bhayaū
puni laghu rūp pavanasut layaū

verses.sa:
सुनु माता साखामृग नहिं बल बुद्धि बिसाल ।
प्रभु प्रताप तें गरुड़हि खाइ परम लघु ब्याल ॥
verses.tr:
sunu mātā sākhāmṛg nahiṃ bal buddhi bisāl
prabhu pratāp teṃ garur̤ahi khāi param laghu byāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: If, Raghubir only knew, be would make no delay. Rama's shafts, like the rays of the rising sun, will scatter the darkling demon host. I would have carried you away at once myself, but, I swear to you by Rama, that I have not received his order to do so. Wait patiently, madam, for a few days, and he will arrive with his monkeys, will slaughter the demons, and take you away, so that Narad and the other seers will glorify him io all the three spheres of creation.” ‘Are all the monkeys, my son, like you? the demon warriors are very powerful, and my soul is sorely disquieted.” On hearing this, the monkey showed himself in his natural form, his body in bulk like a mountain of gold, terrible in battle, and of vast strength; then Sita
took comfort at heart, and he again resumed a diminutive appearance.
“Hearken, lady; the monkeys have no great strength or wit of their own, but by the Lord’s favour even a snake, small as it is, might swallow Gartir.”’

sections.label: Doha 17
sections.name: देखि बुद्धि बल निपुन कपि कहेउ जानकीं जाहु

verses.sa:
मन संतोष सुनत कपि बानी ।
भगति प्रताप तेज बल सानी ॥
verses.tr:
man saṃtoṣ sunat kapi bānī
bhagati pratāp tej bal sānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आसिष दीन्हि रामप्रिय जाना ।
होहु तात बल सील निधाना ॥
verses.tr:
āsiṣ dīnhi rāmapriya jānā
hohu tāt bal sīl nidhānā

verses.sa:
अजर अमर गुननिधि सुत होहू ।
करहुँ बहुत रघुनायक छोहू ॥
verses.tr:
ajar amar gunanidhi sut hohū
karahum̐ bahut raghunāyak chohū

verses.sa:
करहुँ कृपा प्रभु अस सुनि काना ।
निर्भर प्रेम मगन हनुमाना ॥
verses.tr:
karahum̐ kṛpā prabhu as suni kānā
nirbhar prem magan hanumānā

verses.sa:
बार बार नाएसि पद सीसा ।
बोला बचन जोरि कर कीसा ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār nāesi pad sīsā
bolā bacan jori kar kīsā

verses.sa:
अब कृतकृत्य भयउँ मैं माता ।
आसिष तव अमोघ बिख्याता ॥
verses.tr:
ab kṛtakṛtya bhayaum̐ maiṃ mātā
āsiṣ tav amogh bikhyātā

verses.sa:
सुनहु मातु मोहि अतिसय भूखा ।
लागि देखि सुंदर फल रूखा ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu mātu mohi atisaya bhūkhā
lāgi dekhi suṃdar phal rūkhā

verses.sa:
सुनु सुत करहिं बिपिन रखवारी ।
परम सुभट रजनीचर भारी ॥
verses.tr:
sunu sut karahiṃ bipin rakhavārī
param subhaṭ rajanīcar bhārī

verses.sa:
तिन्ह कर भय माता मोहि नाहीं ।
जौं तुम्ह सुख मानहु मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tinh kar bhaya mātā mohi nāhīṃ
jauṃ tumh sukh mānahu man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
देखि बुद्धि बल निपुन कपि कहेउ जानकीं जाहु ।
रघुपति चरन हृदयँ धरि तात मधुर फल खाहु ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi buddhi bal nipun kapi kaheu jānakīṃ jāhu
raghupati caran hṛdayam̐ dhari tāt madhur phal khāhu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: As she hearkened to the monkey's speech, so full of glorious faith and noble confidence, her mind became easy, she recognized his love for Rama and gave him her blessing: “May you abound, my son, in all strength and virtue; may neither age nor death affect your good qualities, and may you be ever constant in your devotion to Rama, and may the Lord be gracious to you.” Hearing these words, Hanuman became utterly overwhelmed with emotion; again and again he bowed his head at her feet, and with clasped hands spoke thus: ‘Now, Judy, I am fully rewarded; for your blessing is known to be effectual. But hearken, madam, I am frightfully hungry and I see the trees laden with delicious fruit.” ‘‘ Know, my son, that this grove is guarded by most valiant and formidable demons.” ‘TI am not afraid of them, mother, if only you will keep your mind easy.
Seeing the monkey so strong and sagacious, Janaki said: “Go, my son, and eat of this pleasant fruit, with your heart fixed on Hari’s feet.

sections.label: Doha 18
sections.name: कछु मारेसि कछु मर्देसि कछु मिलएसि धरि धूरि

verses.sa:
चलेउ नाइ सिरु पैठेउ बागा ।
फल खाएसि तरु तोरैं लागा ॥
verses.tr:
caleu nāi siru paiṭheu bāgā
phal khāesi taru toraiṃ lāgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रहे तहाँ बहु भट रखवारे ।
कछु मारेसि कछु जाइ पुकारे ॥
verses.tr:
rahe tahām̐ bahu bhaṭ rakhavāre
kachu māresi kachu jāi pukāre

verses.sa:
नाथ एक आवा कपि भारी ।
तेहिं असोक बाटिका उजारी ॥
verses.tr:
nāth ek āvā kapi bhārī
tehiṃ asok bāṭikā ujārī

verses.sa:
खाएसि फल अरु बिटप उपारे ।
रच्छक मर्दि मर्दि महि डारे ॥
verses.tr:
khāesi phal aru biṭap upāre
racchak mardi mardi mahi ḍāre

verses.sa:
सुनि रावन पठए भट नाना ।
तिन्हहि देखि गर्जेउ हनुमाना ॥
verses.tr:
suni rāvan paṭhae bhaṭ nānā
tinhahi dekhi garjeu hanumānā

verses.sa:
सब रजनीचर कपि संघारे ।
गए पुकारत कछु अधमारे ॥
verses.tr:
sab rajanīcar kapi saṃghāre
gae pukārat kachu adhamāre

verses.sa:
पुनि पठयउ तेहिं अच्छकुमारा ।
चला संग लै सुभट अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
puni paṭhayau tehiṃ acchakumārā
calā saṃg lai subhaṭ apārā

verses.sa:
आवत देखि बिटप गहि तर्जा ।
ताहि निपाति महाधुनि गर्जा ॥
verses.tr:
āvat dekhi biṭap gahi tarjā
tāhi nipāti mahādhuni garjā

verses.sa:
कछु मारेसि कछु मर्देसि कछु मिलएसि धरि धूरि ।
कछु पुनि जाइ पुकारे प्रभु मर्कट बल भूरि ॥
verses.tr:
kachu māresi kachu mardesi kachu milaesi dhari dhūri
kachu puni jāi pukāre prabhu markaṭ bal bhūri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Jie bowed his bead and went and entered the garden and having eaten of the fruit began breaking down the trees. A number of stalwart watchmen were posted there; some he killed, the others went and called for help: ‘“ My Lord, an enormous monkey has come and rooted up the Asoka grove; he has eaten the fruit and broken down the trees, and with many a blow laid the watchmen on the ground.” On hearing this, Ravan despatched a number of his champions, At the sight of them Hanuman roared like thunder and overthrew the whole demon host;a few, more dead than alive, ran off shrieking. He then sent the young prince Aksha, who took with him an immense number of his best warriors. Seeing them approach he seized a tree, which he brandished and with an awful roar swept them down with it.
Some he hacked, some he crushed, some he laid low in the dust; some got back and cried “My lord, this monkey is too strong for us.”

sections.label: Doha 19
sections.name: ब्रह्म अस्त्र तेहिं साँधा कपि मन कीन्ह बिचार

verses.sa:
सुनि सुत बध लंकेस रिसाना ।
पठएसि मेघनाद बलवाना ॥
verses.tr:
suni sut badh laṃkes risānā
paṭhaesi meghanād balavānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मारसि जनि सुत बांधेसु ताही ।
देखिअ कपिहि कहाँ कर आही ॥
verses.tr:
mārasi jani sut bāṃdhesu tāhī
dekhia kapihi kahām̐ kar āhī

verses.sa:
चला इंद्रजित अतुलित जोधा ।
बंधु निधन सुनि उपजा क्रोधा ॥
verses.tr:
calā iṃdrajit atulit jodhā
baṃdhu nidhan suni upajā krodhā

verses.sa:
कपि देखा दारुन भट आवा ।
कटकटाइ गर्जा अरु धावा ॥
verses.tr:
kapi dekhā dārun bhaṭ āvā
kaṭakaṭāi garjā aru dhāvā

verses.sa:
अति बिसाल तरु एक उपारा ।
बिरथ कीन्ह लंकेस कुमारा ॥
verses.tr:
ati bisāl taru ek upārā
birath kīnh laṃkes kumārā

verses.sa:
रहे महाभट ताके संगा ।
गहि गहि कपि मर्दइ निज अंगा ॥
verses.tr:
rahe mahābhaṭ tāke saṃgā
gahi gahi kapi mardai nij aṃgā

verses.sa:
तिन्हहि निपाति ताहि सन बाजा ।
भिरे जुगल मानहुँ गजराजा ॥
verses.tr:
tinhahi nipāti tāhi san bājā
bhire jugal mānahum̐ gajarājā

verses.sa:
मुठिका मारि चढ़ा तरु जाई ।
ताहि एक छन मुरुछा आई ॥
verses.tr:
muṭhikā māri car̤hā taru jāī
tāhi ek chan muruchā āī

verses.sa:
उठि बहोरि कीन्हिसि बहु माया ।
जीति न जाइ प्रभंजन जाया ॥
verses.tr:
uṭhi bahori kīnhisi bahu māyā
jīti na jāi prabhaṃjan jāyā

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म अस्त्र तेहिं साँधा कपि मन कीन्ह बिचार ।
जौं न ब्रह्मसर मानउँ महिमा मिटइ अपार ॥
verses.tr:
brahm astr tehiṃ sām̐dhā kapi man kīnh bicār
jauṃ na brahmasar mānaum̐ mahimā miṭai apār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When he heard of his son’s death, the king of Lanka was furious and he sent the valiant Meghnad. ‘“ Do not kill him, my son, but bind him; I would fain see this monkey and where he has come from.” Indrajit sallied forth, a peerless champion, full of fury at the tidings of his brother’s death.

When the monkey saw this formidable warrior draw near, he ground his teeth, and with a roar rushed forward and tore up a tree of enormous size, with which he swept the prince of Lanka from his car. As for the mighty men of war who accompanied his, he seized them one by one and crushed them by his weight. Having finished them off, he closed with their leader. It was like the encounter of two lordly elephants. After striking him a blow with his fist, he went and climbed a tree, while for a momenta swoon came over his antagonist. But again he arose and practised many enchantment; still the Wind god’s son was not to be vanquished. Dohd 19.
On his making ready Brahma's magical weapon, the monkey thought within himself, “‘ If I do not submit to Brahma’s shaft, its infinite virtue will have failed.”

sections.label: Doha 20
sections.name: कपिहि बिलोकि दसानन बिहसा कहि दुर्बाद

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मबान कपि कहुँ तेहि मारा ।
परतिहुँ बार कटकु संघारा ॥
verses.tr:
brahmabān kapi kahum̐ tehi mārā
paratihum̐ bār kaṭaku saṃghārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहि देखा कपि मुरुछित भयऊ ।
नागपास बाँधेसि लै गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tehi dekhā kapi muruchit bhayaū
nāgapās bām̐dhesi lai gayaū

verses.sa:
जासु नाम जपि सुनहु भवानी ।
भव बंधन काटहिं नर ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu nām japi sunahu bhavānī
bhav baṃdhan kāṭahiṃ nar gyānī

verses.sa:
तासु दूत कि बंध तरु आवा ।
प्रभु कारज लगि कपिहिं बँधावा ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu dūt ki baṃdh taru āvā
prabhu kāraj lagi kapihiṃ bam̐dhāvā

verses.sa:
कपि बंधन सुनि निसिचर धाए ।
कौतुक लागि सभाँ सब आए ॥
verses.tr:
kapi baṃdhan suni nisicar dhāe
kautuk lāgi sabhām̐ sab āe

verses.sa:
दसमुख सभा दीखि कपि जाई ।
कहि न जाइ कछु अति प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
dasamukh sabhā dīkhi kapi jāī
kahi na jāi kachu ati prabhutāī

verses.sa:
कर जोरें सुर दिसिप बिनीता ।
भृकुटि बिलोकत सकल सभीता ॥
verses.tr:
kar joreṃ sur disip binītā
bhṛkuṭi bilokat sakal sabhītā

verses.sa:
देखि प्रताप न कपि मन संका ।
जिमि अहिगन महुँ गरुड़ असंका ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi pratāp na kapi man saṃkā
jimi ahigan mahum̐ garur̤ asaṃkā

verses.sa:
कपिहि बिलोकि दसानन बिहसा कहि दुर्बाद ।
सुत बध सुरति कीन्हि पुनि उपजा हृदयँ बिषाद ॥
verses.tr:
kapihi biloki dasānan bihasā kahi durbād
sut badh surati kīnhi puni upajā hṛdayam̐ biṣād
verses.head: दोहा

trans: He launched the magic dart against the monkey, who overthrew a host asthe fell. When he saw that he had swooned, he bound him with a running noose and carried him off. Observe, Bhavani; the messenger of the god, by the repetition of whose name wise men cut the bonds of existence, himself came under bondage, or rather in his lord’s service submitted to be bound. When the demons heard that the monkey had been bound, they all rushed to the palace to see the sight. The majesty of Ravan’s court on the monkey’s arrival there struck him as being beyond all description. The gods and regents of the air, standing humbly with clasped hands, were all in dismay, if they saw him frown. But the monkey’s soul was no more disturbed at the sight of his majesty than Gartir would be frightened by any number of snakes.
When Ravan saw the monkey, he laughed aloud and mocked him; then again he remembered his son's death and his soul grew sad.

sections.label: Doha 21
sections.name: जाके बल लवलेस तें जितेहु चराचर झारि

verses.sa:
कह लंकेस कवन तैं कीसा ।
केहिं के बल घालेहि बन खीसा ॥
verses.tr:
kah laṃkes kavan taiṃ kīsā
kehiṃ ke bal ghālehi ban khīsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
की धौं श्रवन सुनेहि नहिं मोही ।
देखउँ अति असंक सठ तोही ॥
verses.tr:
kī dhauṃ śravan sunehi nahiṃ mohī
dekhaum̐ ati asaṃk saṭh tohī

verses.sa:
मारे निसिचर केहिं अपराधा ।
कहु सठ तोहि न प्रान कइ बाधा ॥
verses.tr:
māre nisicar kehiṃ aparādhā
kahu saṭh tohi na prān kai bādhā

verses.sa:
सुन रावन ब्रह्मांड निकाया ।
पाइ जासु बल बिरचित माया ॥
verses.tr:
sun rāvan brahmāṃḍ nikāyā
pāi jāsu bal biracit māyā

verses.sa:
जाकें बल बिरंचि हरि ईसा ।
पालत सृजत हरत दससीसा ॥
verses.tr:
jākeṃ bal biraṃci hari īsā
pālat sṛjat harat dasasīsā

verses.sa:
जा बल सीस धरत सहसानन ।
अंडकोस समेत गिरि कानन ॥
verses.tr:
jā bal sīs dharat sahasānan
aṃḍakos samet giri kānan

verses.sa:
धरइ जो बिबिध देह सुरत्राता ।
तुम्ह ते सठन्ह सिखावनु दाता ॥
verses.tr:
dharai jo bibidh deh suratrātā
tumh te saṭhanh sikhāvanu dātā

verses.sa:
हर कोदंड कठिन जेहि भंजा ।
तेहि समेत नृप दल मद गंजा ॥
verses.tr:
har kodaṃḍ kaṭhin jehi bhaṃjā
tehi samet nṛp dal mad gaṃjā

verses.sa:
खर दूषन त्रिसिरा अरु बाली ।
बधे सकल अतुलित बलसाली ॥
verses.tr:
khar dūṣan trisirā aru bālī
badhe sakal atulit balasālī

verses.sa:
जाके बल लवलेस तें जितेहु चराचर झारि ।
तासु दूत मैं जा करि हरि आनेहु प्रिय नारि ॥
verses.tr:
jāke bal lavales teṃ jitehu carācar jhāri
tāsu dūt maiṃ jā kari hari ānehu priya nāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said the King of LankA: ** Who are you, monkey, and
by whose might have you wrought the destruction of the a SS 1 The weapon had been given to Meghnad by Brahma with a promise

that it should never fail. Hanuman therefore submits to it i Brahma’s promise might not be falsified, pa LE a No grove? What, do not you hear me I see you are an un-commonly bold varlet. For what offence did you put the demons to death? Speak, wretch; as you value your life.” ** Hearken, Ravan; He by whose might Maya creates this universal sphere; hy whose might Brahma, Vishnu, and Siva produce, maintain and destroy the world; by whose might the thousand-headed serpent supports on his pate the mundane egg with its mountains and forests; who assumes various forms in order to befriend the gods and to give a lesson to wretches like you; who broke Siva’s stubborn bow and crushed your pride and that of the assembled kings: who slew Khara and Dushan and Trisira and Bali, in spite of their matchless strength:
‘By the slightest exercise of whose might the entire mass of creation, animate and inanimate, exists; he it is whose messenger I am, and it is his beloved spouse whom you have stolen away.

sections.label: Doha 22
sections.name: प्रनतपाल रघुनायक करुना सिंधु खरारि

verses.sa:
जानउँ मैं तुम्हारि प्रभुताई ।
सहसबाहु सन परी लराई ॥
verses.tr:
jānaum̐ maiṃ tumhāri prabhutāī
sahasabāhu san parī larāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
समर बालि सन करि जसु पावा ।
सुनि कपि बचन बिहसि बिहरावा ॥
verses.tr:
samar bāli san kari jasu pāvā
suni kapi bacan bihasi biharāvā

verses.sa:
खायउँ फल प्रभु लागी भूँखा ।
कपि सुभाव तें तोरेउँ रूखा ॥
verses.tr:
khāyaum̐ phal prabhu lāgī bhūm̐khā
kapi subhāv teṃ toreum̐ rūkhā

verses.sa:
सब कें देह परम प्रिय स्वामी ।
मारहिं मोहि कुमारग गामी ॥
verses.tr:
sab keṃ deh param priya svāmī
mārahiṃ mohi kumārag gāmī

verses.sa:
जिन्ह मोहि मारा ते मैं मारे ।
तेहि पर बाँधेउ तनयँ तुम्हारे ॥
verses.tr:
jinh mohi mārā te maiṃ māre
tehi par bām̐dheu tanayam̐ tumhāre

verses.sa:
मोहि न कछु बाँधे कइ लाजा ।
कीन्ह चहउँ निज प्रभु कर काजा ॥
verses.tr:
mohi na kachu bām̐dhe kai lājā
kīnh cahaum̐ nij prabhu kar kājā

verses.sa:
बिनती करउँ जोरि कर रावन ।
सुनहु मान तजि मोर सिखावन ॥
verses.tr:
binatī karaum̐ jori kar rāvan
sunahu mān taji mor sikhāvan

verses.sa:
देखहु तुम्ह निज कुलहि बिचारी ।
भ्रम तजि भजहु भगत भय हारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhahu tumh nij kulahi bicārī
bhram taji bhajahu bhagat bhaya hārī

verses.sa:
जाकें डर अति काल डेराई ।
जो सुर असुर चराचर खाई ॥
verses.tr:
jākeṃ ḍar ati kāl ḍerāī
jo sur asur carācar khāī

verses.sa:
तासों बयरु कबहुँ नहिं कीजै ।
मोरे कहें जानकी दीजै ॥
verses.tr:
tāsoṃ bayaru kabahum̐ nahiṃ kījai
more kaheṃ jānakī dījai

verses.sa:
प्रनतपाल रघुनायक करुना सिंधु खरारि ।
गएँ सरन प्रभु राखिहैं तव अपराध बिसारि ॥
verses.tr:
pranatapāl raghunāyak karunā siṃdhu kharāri
gaem̐ saran prabhu rākhihaiṃ tav aparādh bisāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I know your power; you had a fight with Sahasra-bhuj, and also gained renown io your conflict with Bali.” He heard what the monkey said, but smiled as though he heard not. “a ate the fruit, my lord, because [ was hungry, and then like a monkey began breaking the boughs. Every one, master, loves his life more than aught else; those good-for-nothing fellows fell upon me, and I gave them blow for blow. Thereupon your son put me in bonds—bonds that Iam in no way ashamed of—for my only object is to accomplish my master’s business. Ravan, I implore you with folded hands, abandon your pride and attend to my advice, Have some consideration for your own family; cease to go astray and adore him, who relieves his worshippers from every anxiety. Never fight against him, for fear of whom Death trembles exceedingly; even Death, who devours all else, gods and demons, animate and inanimate creation alike. Give up Sita, as I tell] you.
Rama is the protector of suppliants; Kharari is a very

sections.label: Doha 23
sections.name: मोहमूल बहु सूल प्रद त्यागहु तम अभिमान

verses.sa:
राम चरन पंकज उर धरहू ।
लंका अचल राज तुम्ह करहू ॥
verses.tr:
rām caran paṃkaj ur dharahū
laṃkā acal rāj tumh karahū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रिषि पुलिस्त जसु बिमल मंयका ।
तेहि ससि महुँ जनि होहु कलंका ॥
verses.tr:
riṣi pulist jasu bimal maṃyakā
tehi sasi mahum̐ jani hohu kalaṃkā

verses.sa:
राम नाम बिनु गिरा न सोहा ।
देखु बिचारि त्यागि मद मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
rām nām binu girā na sohā
dekhu bicāri tyāgi mad mohā

verses.sa:
बसन हीन नहिं सोह सुरारी ।
सब भूषण भूषित बर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
basan hīn nahiṃ soh surārī
sab bhūṣaṇ bhūṣit bar nārī

verses.sa:
राम बिमुख संपति प्रभुताई ।
जाइ रही पाई बिनु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām bimukh saṃpati prabhutāī
jāi rahī pāī binu pāī

verses.sa:
सजल मूल जिन्ह सरितन्ह नाहीं ।
बरषि गए पुनि तबहिं सुखाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sajal mūl jinh saritanh nāhīṃ
baraṣi gae puni tabahiṃ sukhāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनु दसकंठ कहउँ पन रोपी ।
बिमुख राम त्राता नहिं कोपी ॥
verses.tr:
sunu dasakaṃṭh kahaum̐ pan ropī
bimukh rām trātā nahiṃ kopī

verses.sa:
संकर सहस बिष्नु अज तोही ।
सकहिं न राखि राम कर द्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
saṃkar sahas biṣnu aj tohī
sakahiṃ na rākhi rām kar drohī

verses.sa:
मोहमूल बहु सूल प्रद त्यागहु तम अभिमान ।
भजहु राम रघुनायक कृपा सिंधु भगवान ॥
verses.tr:
mohamūl bahu sūl prad tyāgahu tam abhimān
bhajahu rām raghunāyak kṛpā siṃdhu bhagavān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ocean of compassion; turn to him for protection, and the Lord will forget your offences and will shelter you.

Take Rama's lotus feet to your heart and reign for ever at Lanka. The glory of saint Pulastya is stainless as the moon; be not make yourself a spot on its brightness. Unless Rama's name be in it, no speech has any charm: Think and see for yourself, apart from pride and vanity. Without her clothes, RAvan, a modest woman, however richly adorned with jewels, is a shameful sight; and so is wealth, or dominion, without Rama, gone at once, gotten asif not gotten at all. Those rivers, that have no peren-nial source, flow only after rain and then soon dry up again. Hearken, Ravan; I tell you on my oath, if Rama is against you, there is none who can save you. Siva, Seshnag, Vishnu and Brahma cannot protect you, if you are Rama’s enemy.
Arrogance is a root fruitful of many thorns; abandon violence and pride, and worship Rama, the prince of the Raghu race, the Ocean of Compassion, the Lord God.”

sections.label: Doha 24
sections.name: कपि कें ममता पूँछ पर सबहि कहउँ समुझाइ

verses.sa:
जदपि कहि कपि अति हित बानी ।
भगति बिबेक बिरति नय सानी ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi kahi kapi ati hit bānī
bhagati bibek birati naya sānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बोला बिहसि महा अभिमानी ।
मिला हमहि कपि गुर बड़ ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
bolā bihasi mahā abhimānī
milā hamahi kapi gur bar̤ gyānī

verses.sa:
मृत्यु निकट आई खल तोही ।
लागेसि अधम सिखावन मोही ॥
verses.tr:
mṛtyu nikaṭ āī khal tohī
lāgesi adham sikhāvan mohī

verses.sa:
उलटा होइहि कह हनुमाना ।
मतिभ्रम तोर प्रगट मैं जाना ॥
verses.tr:
ulaṭā hoihi kah hanumānā
matibhram tor pragaṭ maiṃ jānā

verses.sa:
सुनि कपि बचन बहुत खिसिआना ।
बेगि न हरहुँ मूढ़ कर प्राना ॥
verses.tr:
suni kapi bacan bahut khisiānā
begi na harahum̐ mūr̤h kar prānā

verses.sa:
सुनत निसाचर मारन धाए ।
सचिवन्ह सहित बिभीषनु आए ॥
verses.tr:
sunat nisācar māran dhāe
sacivanh sahit bibhīṣanu āe

verses.sa:
नाइ सीस करि बिनय बहूता ।
नीति बिरोध न मारिअ दूता ॥
verses.tr:
nāi sīs kari binaya bahūtā
nīti birodh na māria dūtā

verses.sa:
आन दंड कछु करिअ गोसाँई ।
सबहीं कहा मंत्र भल भाई ॥
verses.tr:
ān daṃḍ kachu karia gosām̐ī
sabahīṃ kahā maṃtr bhal bhāī

verses.sa:
सुनत बिहसि बोला दसकंधर ।
अंग भंग करि पठइअ बंदर ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bihasi bolā dasakaṃdhar
aṃg bhaṃg kari paṭhaia baṃdar

verses.sa:
कपि कें ममता पूँछ पर सबहि कहउँ समुझाइ ।
तेल बोरि पट बाँधि पुनि पावक देहु लगाइ ॥
verses.tr:
kapi keṃ mamatā pūm̐ch par sabahi kahaum̐ samujhāi
tel bori paṭ bām̐dhi puni pāvak dehu lagāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Though the monkey be spoke him in such friendly wise, in words full of faith and discretion, piety and sound judgment, he laughed and replied with the highest disdain: “« What a sage adviser I have found, andina monkey too! Wretch, you have come within an inch of death for daring to give me such vile counsel.” ‘It will be contrariwise” said Hanuman; “you will acknowledge the error of your soul, I know well.” Onhearing the monkey's words, he ground his teeth in a fury. “Quick, some of you, and put an end to this fool’s life.” The demons obeyed and rushed forward to slay him, but Vibhishan and his ministers advanced and bowing the head made humble petition: “It is against: all statecraft: an ambassador must not be killed. Punish him in some other way, Sire.” All exclaimed to one another, ‘this is sound counsel, friend,’ Ravan on hearing it,
replied with a laugh: ‘Let the monkey go then, but multi-late first.
A monkey is proud of his tail " (so he went on to say) “bind it with rags steeped in oil and then set fire to them.

sections.label: Doha 25
sections.name: हरि प्रेरित तेहि अवसर चले मरुत उनचास

verses.sa:
पूँछहीन बानर तहँ जाइहि ।
तब सठ निज नाथहि लइ आइहि ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐chahīn bānar taham̐ jāihi
tab saṭh nij nāthahi lai āihi
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जिन्ह कै कीन्हसि बहुत बड़ाई ।
देखेउँमैं तिन्ह कै प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
jinh kai kīnhasi bahut bar̤āī
dekheum̐maiṃ tinh kai prabhutāī

verses.sa:
बचन सुनत कपि मन मुसुकाना ।
भइ सहाय सारद मैं जाना ॥
verses.tr:
bacan sunat kapi man musukānā
bhai sahāya sārad maiṃ jānā

verses.sa:
जातुधान सुनि रावन बचना ।
लागे रचैं मूढ़ सोइ रचना ॥
verses.tr:
jātudhān suni rāvan bacanā
lāge racaiṃ mūr̤h soi racanā

verses.sa:
रहा न नगर बसन घृत तेला ।
बाढ़ी पूँछ कीन्ह कपि खेला ॥
verses.tr:
rahā na nagar basan ghṛt telā
bār̤hī pūm̐ch kīnh kapi khelā

verses.sa:
कौतुक कहँ आए पुरबासी ।
मारहिं चरन करहिं बहु हाँसी ॥
verses.tr:
kautuk kaham̐ āe purabāsī
mārahiṃ caran karahiṃ bahu hām̐sī

verses.sa:
बाजहिं ढोल देहिं सब तारी ।
नगर फेरि पुनि पूँछ प्रजारी ॥
verses.tr:
bājahiṃ ḍhol dehiṃ sab tārī
nagar pheri puni pūm̐ch prajārī

verses.sa:
पावक जरत देखि हनुमंता ।
भयउ परम लघु रुप तुरंता ॥
verses.tr:
pāvak jarat dekhi hanumaṃtā
bhayau param laghu rup turaṃtā

verses.sa:
निबुकि चढ़ेउ कपि कनक अटारीं ।
भई सभीत निसाचर नारीं ॥
verses.tr:
nibuki car̤heu kapi kanak aṭārīṃ
bhaī sabhīt nisācar nārīṃ

verses.sa:
हरि प्रेरित तेहि अवसर चले मरुत उनचास ।
अट्टहास करि गर्ज़ा कपि बढ़ि लाग अकास ॥
verses.tr:
hari prerit tehi avasar cale marut unacās
aṭṭahās kari garzā kapi bar̤hi lāg akās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The poor tailless wretch can then go back and fetch his master, and [ shall have an opportunity of seeing his might, whom he has so extravagantly exalted.” The monkey smiled to himself to hear this. ‘Sderad, I know, will help me.’ Obedient to Ravan’s command the demons began making their foolish preparations. Nota rag was left in the city nor a drop of ght or oil, to such a length the tail had grown. Then they made sport of him. The citizens Crowded to see the sight, and struck him with their feet and jeered him greatly, and with beating of drums and clapping of hands they took him through the city and set fire to bistail. When Hanuman saw the fire blazing, he at once reduced himself toa very diminutive size, and -slip-ping out of his bonds sprang on to the upper story of the gilded palace, to the dismay of the giant’s wives.
That instant the forty-nine winds, whom Hari had sent, began to blow; the monkey shouted with roars of laughter and swelled so big that he touched the sky.

sections.label: Doha 26
sections.name: पूँछ बुझाइ खोइ श्रम धरि लघु रूप बहोरि

verses.sa:
देह बिसाल परम हरुआई ।
मंदिर तें मंदिर चढ़ धाई ॥
verses.tr:
deh bisāl param haruāī
maṃdir teṃ maṃdir car̤h dhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जरइ नगर भा लोग बिहाला ।
झपट लपट बहु कोटि कराला ॥
verses.tr:
jarai nagar bhā log bihālā
jhapaṭ lapaṭ bahu koṭi karālā

verses.sa:
तात मातु हा सुनिअ पुकारा ।
एहि अवसर को हमहि उबारा ॥
verses.tr:
tāt mātu hā sunia pukārā
ehi avasar ko hamahi ubārā

verses.sa:
हम जो कहा यह कपि नहिं होई ।
बानर रूप धरें सुर कोई ॥
verses.tr:
ham jo kahā yah kapi nahiṃ hoī
bānar rūp dhareṃ sur koī

verses.sa:
साधु अवग्या कर फलु ऐसा ।
जरइ नगर अनाथ कर जैसा ॥
verses.tr:
sādhu avagyā kar phalu aisā
jarai nagar anāth kar jaisā

verses.sa:
जारा नगरु निमिष एक माहीं ।
एक बिभीषन कर गृह नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jārā nagaru nimiṣ ek māhīṃ
ek bibhīṣan kar gṛh nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
ता कर दूत अनल जेहिं सिरिजा ।
जरा न सो तेहि कारन गिरिजा ॥
verses.tr:
tā kar dūt anal jehiṃ sirijā
jarā na so tehi kāran girijā

verses.sa:
उलटि पलटि लंका सब जारी ।
कूदि परा पुनि सिंधु मझारी ॥
verses.tr:
ulaṭi palaṭi laṃkā sab jārī
kūdi parā puni siṃdhu majhārī

verses.sa:
पूँछ बुझाइ खोइ श्रम धरि लघु रूप बहोरि ।
जनकसुता के आगें ठाढ़ भयउ कर जोरि ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐ch bujhāi khoi śram dhari laghu rūp bahori
janakasutā ke āgeṃ ṭhār̤h bhayau kar jori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Of enormous stature and yet marvellous agility, he leaped and ran from palace. to palace. As the city was thus set on fire, the people were at their wits’ end; for the terrible flames burst forth in countless millions of places. ‘Alas! father and mother, hearken to my cry: who will save us now? As said, this is no monkey, but some god in monkey form. This is the result of not taking a good man’s advice; our city is burnt down as though it had no protector.” The city was consumed in an instant of | time, save only Vibhishan’s house; the reason why it escaped, Bhavani, was that he who sent the messenger had
turned upside down and given over to the flames, be threw himself into the middle of the sea.
After extinguishing his tail and recovering from his fatigue, he assumed his old diminutive form and went and stood before Janaki, with hands clasped in prayer.

sections.label: Doha 27
sections.name: जनकसुतहि समुझाइ करि बहु बिधि धीरजु दीन्ह

verses.sa:
मातु मोहि दीजे कछु चीन्हा ।
जैसें रघुनायक मोहि दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
mātu mohi dīje kachu cīnhā
jaiseṃ raghunāyak mohi dīnhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चूड़ामनि उतारि तब दयऊ ।
हरष समेत पवनसुत लयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
cūr̤āmani utāri tab dayaū
haraṣ samet pavanasut layaū

verses.sa:
कहेहु तात अस मोर प्रनामा ।
सब प्रकार प्रभु पूरनकामा ॥
verses.tr:
kahehu tāt as mor pranāmā
sab prakār prabhu pūranakāmā

verses.sa:
दीन दयाल बिरिदु संभारी ।
हरहु नाथ मम संकट भारी ॥
verses.tr:
dīn dayāl biridu saṃbhārī
harahu nāth mam saṃkaṭ bhārī

verses.sa:
तात सक्रसुत कथा सुनाएहु ।
बान प्रताप प्रभुहि समुझाएहु ॥
verses.tr:
tāt sakrasut kathā sunāehu
bān pratāp prabhuhi samujhāehu

verses.sa:
मास दिवस महुँ नाथु न आवा ।
तौ पुनि मोहि जिअत नहिं पावा ॥
verses.tr:
mās divas mahum̐ nāthu na āvā
tau puni mohi jiat nahiṃ pāvā

verses.sa:
कहु कपि केहि बिधि राखौं प्राना ।
तुम्हहू तात कहत अब जाना ॥
verses.tr:
kahu kapi kehi bidhi rākhauṃ prānā
tumhahū tāt kahat ab jānā

verses.sa:
तोहि देखि सीतलि भइ छाती ।
पुनि मो कहुँ सोइ दिनु सो राती ॥
verses.tr:
tohi dekhi sītali bhai chātī
puni mo kahum̐ soi dinu so rātī

verses.sa:
जनकसुतहि समुझाइ करि बहु बिधि धीरजु दीन्ह ।
चरन कमल सिरु नाइ कपि गवनु राम पहिं कीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
janakasutahi samujhāi kari bahu bidhi dhīraju dīnh
caran kamal siru nāi kapi gavanu rām pahiṃ kīnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Be pleased, madam, to give me some token, such as Rama gave me.” She unfastened the jewel in her hair and gave it him.!' The Son of the Wind received it gladly. “Salute him respectfully for me, my son, with these words: ‘my lord, you never fail to fulfil desire and are renowned as the suppliant’s friend; relieve me then from my grievous distress’ Repeat to him, friend, the story of Indra’s son, and remind my lord of the might of his arrows. If he does not come within a month, he will never find me alive. Tell me, monkey, how can I keep myself alive; for you now, my son, speak of going, and it is only the sight of you that has given me any comfort: henceforth day and night will seem to me both alike.”
He did everything he could to console Sita and inspire her with confidence, and then bowed his head at her lotus feet and set forth to rejoin Rama.

sections.label: Doha 28
sections.name: जाइ पुकारे ते सब बन उजार जुबराज

verses.sa:
चलत महाधुनि गर्जेसि भारी ।
गर्भ स्त्रवहिं सुनि निसिचर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
calat mahādhuni garjesi bhārī
garbh stravahiṃ suni nisicar nārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाघि सिंधु एहि पारहि आवा ।
सबद किलकिला कपिन्ह सुनावा ॥
verses.tr:
nāghi siṃdhu ehi pārahi āvā
sabad kilakilā kapinh sunāvā

verses.sa:
हरषे सब बिलोकि हनुमाना ।
नूतन जन्म कपिन्ह तब जाना ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣe sab biloki hanumānā
nūtan janm kapinh tab jānā

verses.sa:
मुख प्रसन्न तन तेज बिराजा ।
कीन्हेसि रामचन्द्र कर काजा ॥
verses.tr:
mukh prasann tan tej birājā
kīnhesi rāmacandr kar kājā

verses.sa:
मिले सकल अति भए सुखारी ।
तलफत मीन पाव जिमि बारी ॥
verses.tr:
mile sakal ati bhae sukhārī
talaphat mīn pāv jimi bārī

verses.sa:
चले हरषि रघुनायक पासा ।
पूँछत कहत नवल इतिहासा ॥
verses.tr:
cale haraṣi raghunāyak pāsā
pūm̐chat kahat naval itihāsā

verses.sa:
तब मधुबन भीतर सब आए ।
अंगद संमत मधु फल खाए ॥
verses.tr:
tab madhuban bhītar sab āe
aṃgad saṃmat madhu phal khāe

verses.sa:
रखवारे जब बरजन लागे ।
मुष्टि प्रहार हनत सब भागे ॥
verses.tr:
rakhavāre jab barajan lāge
muṣṭi prahār hanat sab bhāge

verses.sa:
जाइ पुकारे ते सब बन उजार जुबराज ।
सुनि सुग्रीव हरष कपि करि आए प्रभु काज ॥
verses.tr:
jāi pukāre te sab ban ujār jubarāj
suni sugrīv haraṣ kapi kari āe prabhu kāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: As he went, he roared aloud with such a terrible noise that the wives of the demons, who heard it, were overtaken by premature childbirth. Crossing the sea with a bound he arrived on this side and uttered a cry of joy for the monkeys to hear. At the sight of Hanuman, they were as delighted as if they have been given a new spell of life. ‘Your face is so glad and your whole body so radiant that you cannot but have accomplished Rama’s commission.” All greeted him with as much delight as an expiring fish feels when it gets back into the water; and they set out with joy to rejoin Rama, talking as they. went of all that

had lately occurred. When they had reached the Madhuban, with Angad’s consent they began eating the luscious fruit; the watchmen tried to stop them, but were beaten off with fisticuffs. They then fled,
Crying out that the prince had laid waste the garden. Sugriva rejoiced at the news: “The monkey must have returned, after successfully completing his master’s business.

sections.label: Doha 29
sections.name: प्रीति सहित सब भेटे रघुपति करुना पुंज

verses.sa:
जौं न होति सीता सुधि पाई ।
मधुबन के फल सकहिं कि खाई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ na hoti sītā sudhi pāī
madhuban ke phal sakahiṃ ki khāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि मन बिचार कर राजा ।
आइ गए कपि सहित समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi man bicār kar rājā
āi gae kapi sahit samājā

verses.sa:
आइ सबन्हि नावा पद सीसा ।
मिलेउ सबन्हि अति प्रेम कपीसा ॥
verses.tr:
āi sabanhi nāvā pad sīsā
mileu sabanhi ati prem kapīsā

verses.sa:
पूँछी कुसल कुसल पद देखी ।
राम कृपाँ भा काजु बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐chī kusal kusal pad dekhī
rām kṛpām̐ bhā kāju biseṣī

verses.sa:
नाथ काजु कीन्हेउ हनुमाना ।
राखे सकल कपिन्ह के प्राना ॥
verses.tr:
nāth kāju kīnheu hanumānā
rākhe sakal kapinh ke prānā

verses.sa:
सुनि सुग्रीव बहुरि तेहि मिलेऊ ।
कपिन्ह सहित रघुपति पहिं चलेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
suni sugrīv bahuri tehi mileū
kapinh sahit raghupati pahiṃ caleū

verses.sa:
राम कपिन्ह जब आवत देखा ।
किएँ काजु मन हरष बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
rām kapinh jab āvat dekhā
kiem̐ kāju man haraṣ biseṣā

verses.sa:
फटिक सिला बैठे द्वौ भाई ।
परे सकल कपि चरनन्हि जाई ॥
verses.tr:
phaṭik silā baiṭhe dvau bhāī
pare sakal kapi carananhi jāī

verses.sa:
प्रीति सहित सब भेटे रघुपति करुना पुंज ।
पूँछी कुसल नाथ अब कुसल देखि पद कंज ॥
verses.tr:
prīti sahit sab bheṭe raghupati karunā puṃj
pūm̐chī kusal nāth ab kusal dekhi pad kaṃj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: If they had not got news of Sita, they would never have eaten the fruit of the Madhu-ban.” While the king was thus reasoning within himself, Hanuman and his party arrived. They at once bowed the head at his feet, and he received them with all possible cordiality and asked of their welfare. ‘Tt is well with us now that we have seen your feet. By Rama's favour the business has turned out excellently. Hanuman has accomplished his lord’s purpose and has saved the life of us all.” On hearing this, Sugriva again embraced him and then went on with the monkeys to where Rama was. When Rama saw them coming, he was greatly delighted at the completion of the business. The two brothers were seated on a crystal rock and all the monkeys went and fell at their feet.”
Raghupati in his infinite tenderness greeted them all with much affection and asked of their welfare. ‘All is well with us, my lord, now that we have seen your lotus feet.’

sections.label: Doha 30
sections.name: नाम पाहरु दिवस निसि ध्यान तुम्हार कपाट

verses.sa:
जामवंत कह सुनु रघुराया ।
जा पर नाथ करहु तुम्ह दाया ॥
verses.tr:
jāmavaṃt kah sunu raghurāyā
jā par nāth karahu tumh dāyā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ताहि सदा सुभ कुसल निरंतर ।
सुर नर मुनि प्रसन्न ता ऊपर ॥
verses.tr:
tāhi sadā subh kusal niraṃtar
sur nar muni prasann tā ūpar

verses.sa:
सोइ बिजई बिनई गुन सागर ।
तासु सुजसु त्रेलोक उजागर ॥
verses.tr:
soi bijaī binaī gun sāgar
tāsu sujasu trelok ujāgar

verses.sa:
प्रभु कीं कृपा भयउ सबु काजू ।
जन्म हमार सुफल भा आजू ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu kīṃ kṛpā bhayau sabu kājū
janm hamār suphal bhā ājū

verses.sa:
नाथ पवनसुत कीन्हि जो करनी ।
सहसहुँ मुख न जाइ सो बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
nāth pavanasut kīnhi jo karanī
sahasahum̐ mukh na jāi so baranī

verses.sa:
पवनतनय के चरित सुहाए ।
जामवंत रघुपतिहि सुनाए ॥
verses.tr:
pavanatanaya ke carit suhāe
jāmavaṃt raghupatihi sunāe

verses.sa:
सुनत कृपानिधि मन अति भाए ।
पुनि हनुमान हरषि हियँ लाए ॥
verses.tr:
sunat kṛpānidhi man ati bhāe
puni hanumān haraṣi hiyam̐ lāe

verses.sa:
कहहु तात केहि भाँति जानकी ।
रहति करति रच्छा स्वप्रान की ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu tāt kehi bhām̐ti jānakī
rahati karati racchā svaprān kī

verses.sa:
नाम पाहरु दिवस निसि ध्यान तुम्हार कपाट ।
लोचन निज पद जंत्रित जाहिं प्रान केहिं बाट ॥
verses.tr:
nām pāharu divas nisi dhyān tumhār kapāṭ
locan nij pad jaṃtrit jāhiṃ prān kehiṃ bāṭ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said Jamavant; “Hearken, Raghu-raya; anyone, my lord on whom you show favour will always be prosperous for ever; gods, men and saints will be gracious to him; though victorious he will still remain modest and amiable, and his glory will irradiate all the three spheres of creation. By my lord’s favour the task has been accomplished, and to-day we may well say that our life has been worth living. My lord, to tell the whole of Hanuman’s doings would be too much for a thousand tongues.” Jamavant then proceeded to inform Rama of Hanuman’s principal exploits. The All-merciful was charmed by the recital and again in his joy clasped Hanuman to his bosom. “Tell me, my son, how Janaki isand how she keeps life in her body.”
‘Your name is sentinel over her by night and day; her contemplation of you is asa prison-gate; her eyes are the fetters for her feet; how then is it possible for her life to flit away?

sections.label: Doha 31
sections.name: निमिष निमिष करुनानिधि जाहिं कलप सम बीति

verses.sa:
चलत मोहि चूड़ामनि दीन्ही ।
रघुपति हृदयँ लाइ सोइ लीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
calat mohi cūr̤āmani dīnhī
raghupati hṛdayam̐ lāi soi līnhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाथ जुगल लोचन भरि बारी ।
बचन कहे कछु जनककुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
nāth jugal locan bhari bārī
bacan kahe kachu janakakumārī

verses.sa:
अनुज समेत गहेहु प्रभु चरना ।
दीन बंधु प्रनतारति हरना ॥
verses.tr:
anuj samet gahehu prabhu caranā
dīn baṃdhu pranatārati haranā

verses.sa:
मन क्रम बचन चरन अनुरागी ।
केहि अपराध नाथ हौं त्यागी ॥
verses.tr:
man kram bacan caran anurāgī
kehi aparādh nāth hauṃ tyāgī

verses.sa:
अवगुन एक मोर मैं माना ।
बिछुरत प्रान न कीन्ह पयाना ॥
verses.tr:
avagun ek mor maiṃ mānā
bichurat prān na kīnh payānā

verses.sa:
नाथ सो नयनन्हि को अपराधा ।
निसरत प्रान करिहिं हठि बाधा ॥
verses.tr:
nāth so nayananhi ko aparādhā
nisarat prān karihiṃ haṭhi bādhā

verses.sa:
बिरह अगिनि तनु तूल समीरा ।
स्वास जरइ छन माहिं सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
birah agini tanu tūl samīrā
svās jarai chan māhiṃ sarīrā

verses.sa:
नयन स्त्रवहि जलु निज हित लागी ।
जरैं न पाव देह बिरहागी ॥
verses.tr:
nayan stravahi jalu nij hit lāgī
jaraiṃ na pāv deh birahāgī

verses.sa:
सीता के अति बिपति बिसाला ।
बिनहिं कहें भलि दीनदयाला ॥
verses.tr:
sītā ke ati bipati bisālā
binahiṃ kaheṃ bhali dīnadayālā

verses.sa:
निमिष निमिष करुनानिधि जाहिं कलप सम बीति ।
बेगि चलिय प्रभु आनिअ भुज बल खल दल जीति ॥
verses.tr:
nimiṣ nimiṣ karunānidhi jāhiṃ kalap sam bīti
begi caliya prabhu ānia bhuj bal khal dal jīti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When I was leaving, she gaveme this jewel from her hair.” Raghupati took and clasped it tu his heart, while his eyes overflowed with tears. “And did Sita send any message also?” ‘Embrace the feet of my lord and his brother, crying, O friend of the poor, reliever of the suppliant’s distress; in heart, word and deed, I am devoted to your service; for what offence, my lord, have you deserted me? Of one fault I am myself conscious, in that I still continue to live, though separated from you. But this, my lord, is the fault of my eyes, which prevent my soul from taking flight. In this furnace of bereavement which is fanned by my sighs, my body is as it were a heap of cotton and would be consumed in a moment, but my eyes drop such a flood in self-commiseration that it cannot catch fire. Sita’s distress is so utterly everwhelming and you are so pitiful that it is better not to describe it.
O fountain of mercy, each single moment seems an age ere it passes. Set out at once, my lord, and with your mighty arm vanquish the miscreant crew and deliver her.”

sections.label: Doha 32
sections.name: सुनि प्रभु बचन बिलोकि मुख गात हरषि हनुमंत

verses.sa:
सुनि सीता दुख प्रभु सुख अयना ।
भरि आए जल राजिव नयना ॥
verses.tr:
suni sītā dukh prabhu sukh ayanā
bhari āe jal rājiv nayanā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बचन काँय मन मम गति जाही ।
सपनेहुँ बूझिअ बिपति कि ताही ॥
verses.tr:
bacan kām̐ya man mam gati jāhī
sapanehum̐ būjhia bipati ki tāhī

verses.sa:
कह हनुमंत बिपति प्रभु सोई ।
जब तव सुमिरन भजन न होई ॥
verses.tr:
kah hanumaṃt bipati prabhu soī
jab tav sumiran bhajan na hoī

verses.sa:
केतिक बात प्रभु जातुधान की ।
रिपुहि जीति आनिबी जानकी ॥
verses.tr:
ketik bāt prabhu jātudhān kī
ripuhi jīti ānibī jānakī

verses.sa:
सुनु कपि तोहि समान उपकारी ।
नहिं कोउ सुर नर मुनि तनुधारी ॥
verses.tr:
sunu kapi tohi samān upakārī
nahiṃ kou sur nar muni tanudhārī

verses.sa:
प्रति उपकार करौं का तोरा ।
सनमुख होइ न सकत मन मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
prati upakār karauṃ kā torā
sanamukh hoi na sakat man morā

verses.sa:
सुनु सुत उरिन मैं नाहीं ।
देखेउँ करि बिचार मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sunu sut urin maiṃ nāhīṃ
dekheum̐ kari bicār man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि कपिहि चितव सुरत्राता ।
लोचन नीर पुलक अति गाता ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni kapihi citav suratrātā
locan nīr pulak ati gātā

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन बिलोकि मुख गात हरषि हनुमंत ।
चरन परेउ प्रेमाकुल त्राहि त्राहि भगवंत ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan biloki mukh gāt haraṣi hanumaṃt
caran pareu premākul trāhi trāhi bhagavaṃt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing of Sita’s distress, the lotus eyes of the Lord, the abode of bliss, overflowed with tears, ‘When in thought, word and deed, a believer follows in my steps, what ought he to know of misfortune?” Said Hanuman: “There is no misfortune, my lord, except to forget you and your worship. Of what account are the demons to my lord, who can rout them at once and recover Sita.” ‘Hearken, O monkey; neither god, nor man, nor saint that has ever been born into this world, has been such a benefactor to meas you. What return can I make you ® There is none that occurs to my mind. Mark me, my son; I am not free from my obligation to you; I will think and see what I can do.” Again and again as the deliverer of the
gods gazed upon the monkey, his eyes filled with tears and his whole body quivered with emotion.:
As he listened to his lord’s words and looked upon his face, Hanuman was enraptured, and in an ecstasy of love fell at his feet, orying, ‘save me, save me, O my Lord God.’

sections.label: Doha 33
sections.name: ता कहुँ प्रभु कछु अगम नहिं जा पर तुम्ह अनुकुल

verses.sa:
बार बार प्रभु चहइ उठावा ।
प्रेम मगन तेहि उठब न भावा ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār prabhu cahai uṭhāvā
prem magan tehi uṭhab na bhāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रभु कर पंकज कपि कें सीसा ।
सुमिरि सो दसा मगन गौरीसा ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu kar paṃkaj kapi keṃ sīsā
sumiri so dasā magan gaurīsā

verses.sa:
सावधान मन करि पुनि संकर ।
लागे कहन कथा अति सुंदर ॥
verses.tr:
sāvadhān man kari puni saṃkar
lāge kahan kathā ati suṃdar

verses.sa:
कपि उठाइ प्रभु हृदयँ लगावा ।
कर गहि परम निकट बैठावा ॥
verses.tr:
kapi uṭhāi prabhu hṛdayam̐ lagāvā
kar gahi param nikaṭ baiṭhāvā

verses.sa:
कहु कपि रावन पालित लंका ।
केहि बिधि दहेउ दुर्ग अति बंका ॥
verses.tr:
kahu kapi rāvan pālit laṃkā
kehi bidhi daheu durg ati baṃkā

verses.sa:
प्रभु प्रसन्न जाना हनुमाना ।
बोला बचन बिगत अभिमाना ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu prasann jānā hanumānā
bolā bacan bigat abhimānā

verses.sa:
साखामृग के बड़ि मनुसाई ।
साखा तें साखा पर जाई ॥
verses.tr:
sākhāmṛg ke bar̤i manusāī
sākhā teṃ sākhā par jāī

verses.sa:
नाघि सिंधु हाटकपुर जारा ।
निसिचर गन बिधि बिपिन उजारा ॥
verses.tr:
nāghi siṃdhu hāṭakapur jārā
nisicar gan bidhi bipin ujārā

verses.sa:
सो सब तव प्रताप रघुराई ।
नाथ न कछू मोरि प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
so sab tav pratāp raghurāī
nāth na kachū mori prabhutāī

verses.sa:
ता कहुँ प्रभु कछु अगम नहिं जा पर तुम्ह अनुकुल ।
तब प्रभावँ बड़वानलहिं जारि सकइ खलु तूल ॥
verses.tr:
tā kahum̐ prabhu kachu agam nahiṃ jā par tumh anukul
tab prabhāvam̐ bar̤avānalahiṃ jāri sakai khalu tūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Again and again his lord sought to raise him up, but he was so absorbed in devotion that he would not rise. (As he called to mind the Lord with his lotus hands thus placed on the monkey’s head, Siva himself was overcome with emotion; but again, restraining his feelings, he proceeded with the charming narrative). After raising the monkey, the Lord embraced him and took him by the hand and seated him close by hisside: ‘Tell me,O monkey, about Ravan’s stronghold of Lanka, and how you were able io such an off-hand way to burn down his fort.” Seeing his ~ lord so gracious, Hanuman replied in terms of singular modesty: “A monkey forsooth isa creature of singular prowess to skip about as he does from bough to bough. When I leaped across the sea, burnt down the golden city, routed the demon host and laid waste the grove, it was all done through your power, Raghurai; it was no strength of mine, my lord.
Nothing is difficult for him to whom you are propitious; a mere shred of cotton, were it your pleasure, could burn up the whole submarine fire.”

sections.label: Doha 34
sections.name: कपिपति बेगि बोलाए आए जूथप जूथ

verses.sa:
नाथ भगति अति सुखदायनी ।
देहु कृपा करि अनपायनी ॥
verses.tr:
nāth bhagati ati sukhadāyanī
dehu kṛpā kari anapāyanī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु परम सरल कपि बानी ।
एवमस्तु तब कहेउ भवानी ॥
