verses.tr:
suni prabhu param saral kapi bānī
evamastu tab kaheu bhavānī

verses.sa:
उमा राम सुभाउ जेहिं जाना ।
ताहि भजनु तजि भाव न आना ॥
verses.tr:
umā rām subhāu jehiṃ jānā
tāhi bhajanu taji bhāv na ānā

verses.sa:
यह संवाद जासु उर आवा ।
रघुपति चरन भगति सोइ पावा ॥
verses.tr:
yah saṃvād jāsu ur āvā
raghupati caran bhagati soi pāvā

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन कहहिं कपिबृंदा ।
जय जय जय कृपाल सुखकंदा ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan kahahiṃ kapibṛṃdā
jaya jaya jaya kṛpāl sukhakaṃdā

verses.sa:
तब रघुपति कपिपतिहि बोलावा ।
कहा चलैं कर करहु बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghupati kapipatihi bolāvā
kahā calaiṃ kar karahu banāvā

verses.sa:
अब बिलंबु केहि कारन कीजे ।
तुरत कपिन्ह कहुँ आयसु दीजे ॥
verses.tr:
ab bilaṃbu kehi kāran kīje
turat kapinh kahum̐ āyasu dīje

verses.sa:
कौतुक देखि सुमन बहु बरषी ।
नभ तें भवन चले सुर हरषी ॥
verses.tr:
kautuk dekhi suman bahu baraṣī
nabh teṃ bhavan cale sur haraṣī

verses.sa:
कपिपति बेगि बोलाए आए जूथप जूथ ।
नाना बरन अतुल बल बानर भालु बरूथ ॥
verses.tr:
kapipati begi bolāe āe jūthap jūth
nānā baran atul bal bānar bhālu barūth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Lord smiled much to hear these words, and recognized himas indeed a loving servant. “Ask of me a boon my son, some choice blessing; to-day I will make you happy for ever.” ‘“ Faith, my lord, is the greatest of blessings; of your favour grant me this else unattainable boon.” On hearing the monkey’s pious request, the Lord, Bhavani, responded: ‘So be it.’ O Uma, he who knows Rama's true nature can take pleasure in nothing but his worship: and he who takes this truth to heart has attained to the virtue of faith in Rama. When the assembled monkeys heard the Lord’s reply, they cried ‘glory, glory, glory to the All merciful, the All-blessed.’ Raghupati then summoned the monkey chief and told him to make preparations for the march: ‘What need now for any delay? At once issue orders to the monkeys.” The gods, who had witnessed the spectacle, rained down many flowers and returned with joy from the lower air to their own celestial spheres. Doha 34.

sections.label: Doha 35
sections.name: एहि बिधि जाइ कृपानिधि उतरे सागर तीर

verses.sa:
प्रभु पद पंकज नावहिं सीसा ।
गरजहिं भालु महाबल कीसा ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pad paṃkaj nāvahiṃ sīsā
garajahiṃ bhālu mahābal kīsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखी राम सकल कपि सेना ।
चितइ कृपा करि राजिव नैना ॥
verses.tr:
dekhī rām sakal kapi senā
citai kṛpā kari rājiv nainā

verses.sa:
राम कृपा बल पाइ कपिंदा ।
भए पच्छजुत मनहुँ गिरिंदा ॥
verses.tr:
rām kṛpā bal pāi kapiṃdā
bhae pacchajut manahum̐ giriṃdā

verses.sa:
हरषि राम तब कीन्ह पयाना ।
सगुन भए सुंदर सुभ नाना ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi rām tab kīnh payānā
sagun bhae suṃdar subh nānā

verses.sa:
जासु सकल मंगलमय कीती ।
तासु पयान सगुन यह नीती ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu sakal maṃgalamaya kītī
tāsu payān sagun yah nītī

verses.sa:
प्रभु पयान जाना बैदेहीं ।
फरकि बाम अँग जनु कहि देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu payān jānā baidehīṃ
pharaki bām am̐g janu kahi dehīṃ

verses.sa:
जोइ जोइ सगुन जानकिहि होई ।
असगुन भयउ रावनहि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
joi joi sagun jānakihi hoī
asagun bhayau rāvanahi soī

verses.sa:
चला कटकु को बरनैं पारा ।
गर्जहि बानर भालु अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
calā kaṭaku ko baranaiṃ pārā
garjahi bānar bhālu apārā

verses.sa:
नख आयुध गिरि पादपधारी ।
चले गगन महि इच्छाचारी ॥
verses.tr:
nakh āyudh giri pādapadhārī
cale gagan mahi icchācārī

verses.sa:
केहरिनाद भालु कपि करहीं ।
डगमगाहिं दिग्गज चिक्करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
keharinād bhālu kapi karahīṃ
ḍagamagāhiṃ diggaj cikkarahīṃ

verses.sa:
चिक्करहिं दिग्गज डोल महि गिरि लोल सागर खरभरे ।
मन हरष सभ गंधर्ब सुर मुनि नाग किन्नर दुख टरे ॥
verses.tr:
cikkarahiṃ diggaj ḍol mahi giri lol sāgar kharabhare
man haraṣ sabh gaṃdharb sur muni nāg kinnar dukh ṭare
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
कटकटहिं मर्कट बिकट भट बहु कोटि कोटिन्ह धावहीं ।
जय राम प्रबल प्रताप कोसलनाथ गुन गन गावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭakaṭahiṃ markaṭ bikaṭ bhaṭ bahu koṭi koṭinh dhāvahīṃ
jaya rām prabal pratāp kosalanāth gun gan gāvahīṃ

verses.sa:
सहि सक न भार उदार अहिपति बार बारहिं मोहई ।
गह दसन पुनि पुनि कमठ पृष्ट कठोर सो किमि सोहई ॥
verses.tr:
sahi sak na bhār udār ahipati bār bārahiṃ mohaī
gah dasan puni puni kamaṭh pṛṣṭ kaṭhor so kimi sohaī

verses.sa:
रघुबीर रुचिर प्रयान प्रस्थिति जानि परम सुहावनी ।
जनु कमठ खर्पर सर्पराज सो लिखत अबिचल पावनी ॥
verses.tr:
raghubīr rucir prayān prasthiti jāni param suhāvanī
janu kamaṭh kharpar sarparāj so likhat abical pāvanī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि जाइ कृपानिधि उतरे सागर तीर ।
जहँ तहँ लागे खान फल भालु बिपुल कपि बीर ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi jāi kṛpānidhi utare sāgar tīr
jaham̐ taham̐ lāge khān phal bhālu bipul kapi bīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In obedience to Sugriva’s summons all his hosts of captains came in, differing in colour, but all unequalled in strength, a vast multitude of monkeys and bears,

They bowed the head at the Lord’s lotus feet, those roaring bears and gigantic monkeys. Rama beheld all the monkey host, and turned upon them the gracious glance of his lotus eyes. Each monkey chief was as much emboldened by his favour as Sumeru would be by the recovery of his wings. Rama then sallied forth exulting, and many were the glad and auspicious omens that befell him. It was only befitting that his march should be attended by favourable omens, since in him abide all glory and auspiciousness. Janaki knew of his departure, for her left side throbbed as if to tell her. Every good omen that befell her was converted into an omen of ill for Ravan. Who could adequately describe the army on the road, with the terrible roaring of the monkeys and the bears, how they marched, brandishing rocks and trees and with their talons for weapons, now in the heaven and now on earth, as the fancy moved them. They belowed as if with the voice of a tiger; earth shook and the elephants of the eight quarters trembled.

The elephants of the eight quarters trembled, the earth reeled, the mountains tottered, and the ocean was agitated; the sun and the moon, gods, saints, Nagas, and Kinnars, all rejoiced to know that their troubles were over. Myriads upon myriads of enormous fighting monkeys pressed onwards, snapping, and snarling, singing, glory to Rama's

Conquering might and hymning the praises of Kosala’s lord. The huge serpent king could not support the burden; he staggered again and again, but each time saved himself by clutching in his jaws the hard shell of the tortoise; as though he had mastered the stupendous theme of Raghubir’s glorious expedition, and were inscribing in on the tortoise's back as the most imperishable material to be had.
In such wise the All-merciful marched onwards, till he arrived at the seashore, where the host of bears and fighting monkeys began to devour all the fruit they found. _

sections.label: Doha 36
sections.name: -राम बान अहि गन सरिस निकर निसाचर भेक

verses.sa:
उहाँ निसाचर रहहिं ससंका ।
जब ते जारि गयउ कपि लंका ॥
verses.tr:
uhām̐ nisācar rahahiṃ sasaṃkā
jab te jāri gayau kapi laṃkā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
निज निज गृहँ सब करहिं बिचारा ।
नहिं निसिचर कुल केर उबारा ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij gṛham̐ sab karahiṃ bicārā
nahiṃ nisicar kul ker ubārā

verses.sa:
जासु दूत बल बरनि न जाई ।
तेहि आएँ पुर कवन भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu dūt bal barani na jāī
tehi āem̐ pur kavan bhalāī

verses.sa:
दूतन्हि सन सुनि पुरजन बानी ।
मंदोदरी अधिक अकुलानी ॥
verses.tr:
dūtanhi san suni purajan bānī
maṃdodarī adhik akulānī

verses.sa:
रहसि जोरि कर पति पग लागी ।
बोली बचन नीति रस पागी ॥
verses.tr:
rahasi jori kar pati pag lāgī
bolī bacan nīti ras pāgī

verses.sa:
कंत करष हरि सन परिहरहू ।
मोर कहा अति हित हियँ धरहु ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃt karaṣ hari san pariharahū
mor kahā ati hit hiyam̐ dharahu

verses.sa:
समुझत जासु दूत कइ करनी ।
स्त्रवहीं गर्भ रजनीचर धरनी ॥
verses.tr:
samujhat jāsu dūt kai karanī
stravahīṃ garbh rajanīcar dharanī

verses.sa:
तासु नारि निज सचिव बोलाई ।
पठवहु कंत जो चहहु भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu nāri nij saciv bolāī
paṭhavahu kaṃt jo cahahu bhalāī

verses.sa:
तब कुल कमल बिपिन दुखदाई ।
सीता सीत निसा सम आई ॥
verses.tr:
tab kul kamal bipin dukhadāī
sītā sīt nisā sam āī

verses.sa:
सुनहु नाथ सीता बिनु दीन्हें ।
हित न तुम्हार संभु अज कीन्हें ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu nāth sītā binu dīnheṃ
hit na tumhār saṃbhu aj kīnheṃ

verses.sa:
-राम बान अहि गन सरिस निकर निसाचर भेक ।
जब लगि ग्रसत न तब लगि जतनु करहु तजि टेक ॥
verses.tr:
-rām bān ahi gan saris nikar nisācar bhek
jab lagi grasat na tab lagi jatanu karahu taji ṭek
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On the other hand, the demons had been living in great fear, ever since the time the monkey had left, after burning down the city. Every one kept at home, thinking to himself: “There is no hope of safety for the demon race; if his messenger was so unspeakably powerful, how can the city escape when he comes himself?”’ When Mandodari was informed of what the people were saying, she was still more distrest, and with clasped hands fell at her lord’s feet and thus besought him, in words full of sound judgment: ‘'O my husband, cease to contend against Hari: take my words to your heart as most wholesome advice. His mere messenger did such deeds that our matrons, on hearing them, were overtaken by premature labour; if then you desire your own welfare, call your ministers and send him back his wife. As a frosty night comes upon a bed of lotuses, so has Sita come for the ruin of your race. Hearken, my lord; unless you give up Sita, neither Sambhu nor Brahma can help you.
Rama's arrows are like serpents, and the demon host so many frogs; delay not, but do the best you can before they have snapped you up.”

sections.label: Doha 37
sections.name: सचिव बैद गुर तीनि जौं प्रिय बोलहिं भय आस

verses.sa:
श्रवन सुनी सठ ता करि बानी ।
बिहसा जगत बिदित अभिमानी ॥
verses.tr:
śravan sunī saṭh tā kari bānī
bihasā jagat bidit abhimānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सभय सुभाउ नारि कर साचा ।
मंगल महुँ भय मन अति काचा ॥
verses.tr:
sabhaya subhāu nāri kar sācā
maṃgal mahum̐ bhaya man ati kācā

verses.sa:
जौं आवइ मर्कट कटकाई ।
जिअहिं बिचारे निसिचर खाई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ āvai markaṭ kaṭakāī
jiahiṃ bicāre nisicar khāī

verses.sa:
कंपहिं लोकप जाकी त्रासा ।
तासु नारि सभीत बड़ि हासा ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃpahiṃ lokap jākī trāsā
tāsu nāri sabhīt bar̤i hāsā

verses.sa:
अस कहि बिहसि ताहि उर लाई ।
चलेउ सभाँ ममता अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi bihasi tāhi ur lāī
caleu sabhām̐ mamatā adhikāī

verses.sa:
मंदोदरी हृदयँ कर चिंता ।
भयउ कंत पर बिधि बिपरीता ॥
verses.tr:
maṃdodarī hṛdayam̐ kar ciṃtā
bhayau kaṃt par bidhi biparītā

verses.sa:
बैठेउ सभाँ खबरि असि पाई ।
सिंधु पार सेना सब आई ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭheu sabhām̐ khabari asi pāī
siṃdhu pār senā sab āī

verses.sa:
बूझेसि सचिव उचित मत कहहू ।
ते सब हँसे मष्ट करि रहहू ॥
verses.tr:
būjhesi saciv ucit mat kahahū
te sab ham̐se maṣṭ kari rahahū

verses.sa:
जितेहु सुरासुर तब श्रम नाहीं ।
नर बानर केहि लेखे माही ॥
verses.tr:
jitehu surāsur tab śram nāhīṃ
nar bānar kehi lekhe māhī

verses.sa:
सचिव बैद गुर तीनि जौं प्रिय बोलहिं भय आस ।
राज धर्म तन तीनि कर होइ बेगिहीं नास ॥
verses.tr:
saciv baid gur tīni jauṃ priya bolahiṃ bhaya ās
rāj dharm tan tīni kar hoi begihīṃ nās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The monster heard her prayer and laughed aloud; his arrogance is known throughout the world. “A woman is naturally cast in a timorous mould, and even in prosperity has a mind ill at ease. If the monkey army comes, the poor wretches will all be eaten up by the demons. The very guardians of the spheres trembled for fear of mo; it is quite absurd for my wife to be afraid.” So saying he laughed and embraced her, and then full of inordinate conceit proceeded to the council-chamber. But Mandodari was sore troubled at heart, saying, ‘Heaven is against my lord.’ While he was sitting in court, he received intelligence that the whole army had crossed the sea. Then he enquired of his ministers, ‘Tell me what you think best to be done.’ They all laughed and replied, “Remain quiet. You have Conquered gods and demons without any trouble; of what account can men and monkeys be?”
When these three, a minister, a physician and a spiritual adviser, use fair words, either from fear or hope of reward; dominion, religion and health are all three quickly destroyed.

sections.label: Doha 38
sections.name: काम क्रोध मद लोभ सब नाथ नरक के पंथ

verses.sa:
सोइ रावन कहुँ बनि सहाई ।
अस्तुति करहिं सुनाइ सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
soi rāvan kahum̐ bani sahāī
astuti karahiṃ sunāi sunāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अवसर जानि बिभीषनु आवा ।
भ्राता चरन सीसु तेहिं नावा ॥
verses.tr:
avasar jāni bibhīṣanu āvā
bhrātā caran sīsu tehiṃ nāvā

verses.sa:
पुनि सिरु नाइ बैठ निज आसन ।
बोला बचन पाइ अनुसासन ॥
verses.tr:
puni siru nāi baiṭh nij āsan
bolā bacan pāi anusāsan

verses.sa:
जौ कृपाल पूँछिहु मोहि बाता ।
मति अनुरुप कहउँ हित ताता ॥
verses.tr:
jau kṛpāl pūm̐chihu mohi bātā
mati anurup kahaum̐ hit tātā

verses.sa:
जो आपन चाहै कल्याना ।
सुजसु सुमति सुभ गति सुख नाना ॥
verses.tr:
jo āpan cāhai kalyānā
sujasu sumati subh gati sukh nānā

verses.sa:
सो परनारि लिलार गोसाईं ।
तजउ चउथि के चंद कि नाई ॥
verses.tr:
so paranāri lilār gosāīṃ
tajau cauthi ke caṃd ki nāī

verses.sa:
चौदह भुवन एक पति होई ।
भूतद्रोह तिष्टइ नहिं सोई ॥
verses.tr:
caudah bhuvan ek pati hoī
bhūtadroh tiṣṭai nahiṃ soī

verses.sa:
गुन सागर नागर नर जोऊ ।
अलप लोभ भल कहइ न कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
gun sāgar nāgar nar joū
alap lobh bhal kahai na koū

verses.sa:
काम क्रोध मद लोभ सब नाथ नरक के पंथ ।
सब परिहरि रघुबीरहि भजहु भजहिं जेहि संत ॥
verses.tr:
kām krodh mad lobh sab nāth narak ke paṃth
sab parihari raghubīrahi bhajahu bhajahiṃ jehi saṃt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: This was all the help that Ravan got; they did nothing but sound his praises. Perceiving his opportunity, Vibhishan came and bowed his head at his brother’s feet, then again bowing took his seat on his throne and after obtaining permission spoke thus: ‘As you graciously ask of me my opinion, [ declare it, Sire, to the best of my ability. If you desire your own welfare and glory, with a reputation for wisdom, a prosperous issue and every other happiness, turn away from the face of another man’s wife as from the moon on its fourth day. Though a man were lord of the fourteen spheres, he cannot set himself to oppose the Universal, However amiable and accomplished a person may be, no one will speak well of him if he shows even the slightest covetousness,
Lust, passion, vanity, and covetousness are all paths that lead to hell: adjure them and worship Raghubir, whom all the saints worship.

sections.label: Doha 39
sections.name: बार बार पद लागउँ बिनय करउँ दससीस

verses.sa:
तात राम नहिं नर भूपाला ।
भुवनेस्वर कालहु कर काला ॥
verses.tr:
tāt rām nahiṃ nar bhūpālā
bhuvanesvar kālahu kar kālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म अनामय अज भगवंता ।
ब्यापक अजित अनादि अनंता ॥
verses.tr:
brahm anāmaya aj bhagavaṃtā
byāpak ajit anādi anaṃtā

verses.sa:
गो द्विज धेनु देव हितकारी ।
कृपासिंधु मानुष तनुधारी ॥
verses.tr:
go dvij dhenu dev hitakārī
kṛpāsiṃdhu mānuṣ tanudhārī

verses.sa:
जन रंजन भंजन खल ब्राता ।
बेद धर्म रच्छक सुनु भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
jan raṃjan bhaṃjan khal brātā
bed dharm racchak sunu bhrātā

verses.sa:
ताहि बयरु तजि नाइअ माथा ।
प्रनतारति भंजन रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
tāhi bayaru taji nāia māthā
pranatārati bhaṃjan raghunāthā

verses.sa:
देहु नाथ प्रभु कहुँ बैदेही ।
भजहु राम बिनु हेतु सनेही ॥
verses.tr:
dehu nāth prabhu kahum̐ baidehī
bhajahu rām binu hetu sanehī

verses.sa:
सरन गएँ प्रभु ताहु न त्यागा ।
बिस्व द्रोह कृत अघ जेहि लागा ॥
verses.tr:
saran gaem̐ prabhu tāhu na tyāgā
bisv droh kṛt agh jehi lāgā

verses.sa:
जासु नाम त्रय ताप नसावन ।
सोइ प्रभु प्रगट समुझु जियँ रावन ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu nām traya tāp nasāvan
soi prabhu pragaṭ samujhu jiyam̐ rāvan

verses.sa:
बार बार पद लागउँ बिनय करउँ दससीस ।
परिहरि मान मोह मद भजहु कोसलाधीस ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār pad lāgaum̐ binaya karaum̐ dasasīs
parihari mān moh mad bhajahu kosalādhīs
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
मुनि पुलस्ति निज सिष्य सन कहि पठई यह बात ।
तुरत सो मैं प्रभु सन कही पाइ सुअवसरु तात ॥
verses.tr:
muni pulasti nij siṣya san kahi paṭhaī yah bāt
turat so maiṃ prabhu san kahī pāi suavasaru tāt

trans: Rama, my brother, is no mortal king but the sovereign of the universe, the Fate of Fate itself, the Supreme Spirit,
the imperishable and uncreated God, the benefactor of cows and of Brahmans, of the earth and of the gods;_ who in his

finite mercy has assumed the form of humanity, to rejoice his votaries and to break the ranks of the impious; the bbampion of the Veda and true religion, the saviour of the immortals. Cease to fight against him and humbly bow The head. Raghunath relieves the distress of every suppliant. O my lord, give him back Sita and worship him

with disinterested affection. The lord has never abandoned hoy one who has fled to him for protection, though he were guilty of having ruined the whole world. Know of a truth, Ravan, that it is the lord, he who has for name ‘the saviour from ever calamity,’ who has now appeared among us,

Again and again I lay my head at your feet and utter this my prayers: have done with pride, arrogance and conceit, and worship Rama. These are the words which Saint | Palastya sent in a message to me, and I have at once taken this opportunity of repeating them to you, Sire.”

sections.label: Doha 40
sections.name: तात चरन गहि मागउँ राखहु मोर दुलार

verses.sa:
माल्यवंत अति सचिव सयाना ।
तासु बचन सुनि अति सुख माना ॥
verses.tr:
mālyavaṃt ati saciv sayānā
tāsu bacan suni ati sukh mānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तात अनुज तव नीति बिभूषन ।
सो उर धरहु जो कहत बिभीषन ॥
verses.tr:
tāt anuj tav nīti bibhūṣan
so ur dharahu jo kahat bibhīṣan

verses.sa:
रिपु उतकरष कहत सठ दोऊ ।
दूरि न करहु इहाँ हइ कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ripu utakaraṣ kahat saṭh doū
dūri na karahu ihām̐ hai koū

verses.sa:
माल्यवंत गृह गयउ बहोरी ।
कहइ बिभीषनु पुनि कर जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
mālyavaṃt gṛh gayau bahorī
kahai bibhīṣanu puni kar jorī

verses.sa:
सुमति कुमति सब कें उर रहहीं ।
नाथ पुरान निगम अस कहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sumati kumati sab keṃ ur rahahīṃ
nāth purān nigam as kahahīṃ

verses.sa:
जहाँ सुमति तहँ संपति नाना ।
जहाँ कुमति तहँ बिपति निदाना ॥
verses.tr:
jahām̐ sumati taham̐ saṃpati nānā
jahām̐ kumati taham̐ bipati nidānā

verses.sa:
तव उर कुमति बसी बिपरीता ।
हित अनहित मानहु रिपु प्रीता ॥
verses.tr:
tav ur kumati basī biparītā
hit anahit mānahu ripu prītā

verses.sa:
कालराति निसिचर कुल केरी ।
तेहि सीता पर प्रीति घनेरी ॥
verses.tr:
kālarāti nisicar kul kerī
tehi sītā par prīti ghanerī

verses.sa:
तात चरन गहि मागउँ राखहु मोर दुलार ।
सीत देहु राम कहुँ अहित न होइ तुम्हार ॥
verses.tr:
tāt caran gahi māgaum̐ rākhahu mor dulār
sīt dehu rām kahum̐ ahit na hoi tumhār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: One of his wisest counsellors Malyaven, was greatly rejoiced to hear this speech. “Take to heart, my son, this admirable counsel which your brother Vibhishan has given you.” ‘These two villains who thus magnify my enemies, 8 there no one here who will rid me of them?” Malyavan thereupon returned home, but Vibhishan with clasped hands spoke yet again: “In every one’s breast, my lord, 0 the Vedas and Pur^nas declare, either wisdom or unwisdom finds a dwelling. Where wisdom dwells, there too is every kind of prosperity: and where uowisdom, there is final destruction. In your breast malignant anwisdom has established herself; you take your friends for enemies and your greatest enemy for a friend, being thus extravagantly enamoured of this Sita, who is the very night of Death for be whole demon race. Dohd 40.
_ My brother, I clasp your feet and implore you to take my words in good part’: restore Sita to Rama; it will be much to your advantage.”

sections.label: Doha 41
sections.name: रामु सत्यसंकल्प प्रभु सभा कालबस तोरि

verses.sa:
बुध पुरान श्रुति संमत बानी ।
कही बिभीषन नीति बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
budh purān śruti saṃmat bānī
kahī bibhīṣan nīti bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनत दसानन उठा रिसाई ।
खल तोहि निकट मुत्यु अब आई ॥
verses.tr:
sunat dasānan uṭhā risāī
khal tohi nikaṭ mutyu ab āī

verses.sa:
जिअसि सदा सठ मोर जिआवा ।
रिपु कर पच्छ मूढ़ तोहि भावा ॥
verses.tr:
jiasi sadā saṭh mor jiāvā
ripu kar pacch mūr̤h tohi bhāvā

verses.sa:
कहसि न खल अस को जग माहीं ।
भुज बल जाहि जिता मैं नाही ॥
verses.tr:
kahasi na khal as ko jag māhīṃ
bhuj bal jāhi jitā maiṃ nāhī

verses.sa:
मम पुर बसि तपसिन्ह पर प्रीती ।
सठ मिलु जाइ तिन्हहि कहु नीती ॥
verses.tr:
mam pur basi tapasinh par prītī
saṭh milu jāi tinhahi kahu nītī

verses.sa:
अस कहि कीन्हेसि चरन प्रहारा ।
अनुज गहे पद बारहिं बारा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi kīnhesi caran prahārā
anuj gahe pad bārahiṃ bārā

verses.sa:
उमा संत कइ इहइ बड़ाई ।
मंद करत जो करइ भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
umā saṃt kai ihai bar̤āī
maṃd karat jo karai bhalāī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह पितु सरिस भलेहिं मोहि मारा ।
रामु भजें हित नाथ तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh pitu saris bhalehiṃ mohi mārā
rāmu bhajeṃ hit nāth tumhārā

verses.sa:
सचिव संग लै नभ पथ गयऊ ।
सबहि सुनाइ कहत अस भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
saciv saṃg lai nabh path gayaū
sabahi sunāi kahat as bhayaū

verses.sa:
रामु सत्यसंकल्प प्रभु सभा कालबस तोरि ।
मै रघुबीर सरन अब जाउँ देहु जनि खोरि ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu satyasaṃkalp prabhu sabhā kālabas tori
mai raghubīr saran ab jāum̐ dehu jani khori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Though the words that Vibhishan spoke were wise and prudent, and supported by the authority of the Vedas and >Pur^nas, the Ten-headed rose in wu fury at hearing them:

“Wretch, you are within an inch of your death. It is all owing to me, you villain, that you have been able to live at all; and yet, fool as you are, you take the side of my enemies. Can you tell me, wretch, of any one in the whole world, whom I have not conquered by the might of my arm. You live in my capital, but are in love with hermits; you had better go to them, if you want to preach.” So saying, he spurned him with a kick; but he still continued to clasp him by the feet. ‘You are as it were my father; kill me, if you think proper; but, O my lord, to worship Rama would be far better for you.” This is the virtue of the saints, Uma, that they return good for evil. Taking his ministers with him, he went his way through the air, proclaiming aloud to them all:
‘Rama is the very soul of truth; your countries, my lord, are overpowered by fate; I will now take refuge with, Raghubir; lay no blame to me.”

sections.label: Doha 42
sections.name: जिन्ह पायन्ह के पादुकन्हि भरतु रहे मन लाइ

verses.sa:
अस कहि चला बिभीषनु जबहीं ।
आयूहीन भए सब तबहीं ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi calā bibhīṣanu jabahīṃ
āyūhīn bhae sab tabahīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
साधु अवग्या तुरत भवानी ।
कर कल्यान अखिल कै हानी ॥
verses.tr:
sādhu avagyā turat bhavānī
kar kalyān akhil kai hānī

verses.sa:
रावन जबहिं बिभीषन त्यागा ।
भयउ बिभव बिनु तबहिं अभागा ॥
verses.tr:
rāvan jabahiṃ bibhīṣan tyāgā
bhayau bibhav binu tabahiṃ abhāgā

verses.sa:
चलेउ हरषि रघुनायक पाहीं ।
करत मनोरथ बहु मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
caleu haraṣi raghunāyak pāhīṃ
karat manorath bahu man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
देखिहउँ जाइ चरन जलजाता ।
अरुन मृदुल सेवक सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
dekhihaum̐ jāi caran jalajātā
arun mṛdul sevak sukhadātā

verses.sa:
जे पद परसि तरी रिषिनारी ।
दंडक कानन पावनकारी ॥
verses.tr:
je pad parasi tarī riṣinārī
daṃḍak kānan pāvanakārī

verses.sa:
जे पद जनकसुताँ उर लाए ।
कपट कुरंग संग धर धाए ॥
verses.tr:
je pad janakasutām̐ ur lāe
kapaṭ kuraṃg saṃg dhar dhāe

verses.sa:
हर उर सर सरोज पद जेई ।
अहोभाग्य मै देखिहउँ तेई ॥
verses.tr:
har ur sar saroj pad jeī
ahobhāgya mai dekhihaum̐ teī

verses.sa:
जिन्ह पायन्ह के पादुकन्हि भरतु रहे मन लाइ ।
ते पद आजु बिलोकिहउँ इन्ह नयनन्हि अब जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
jinh pāyanh ke pādukanhi bharatu rahe man lāi
te pad āju bilokihaum̐ inh nayananhi ab jāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After Vibhishan had Left with these words, it was all over with everyone of them. Disrespect to a saint, Bhavani, brings speedy ruin on the most prosperous undertaking. As soon as Vibhishan had left, Ravan lost all his glory and good fortune. But he rejoiced as he went to meet Rama, and revolved in his mind many agreeable anticipation: “I am about to behold his lotus feet, so roseate, so soft, so beneficent to all who wait upon them; at whose touch the Rishi’s wife was delivered from the cure, and the Dandaka forest was sanctified; feet that Sita cherished in her bosom, even while they ran to seize the delusive deer; lotus feet in Siva’s lake-like heart; bow blest am I who am now about to see them |
‘With these very eyes shall I this day behold the feet, whose shoeseven Bharat clasped to his heart.”

sections.label: Doha 43
sections.name: सरनागत कहुँ जे तजहिं निज अनहित अनुमानि

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि करत सप्रेम बिचारा ।
आयउ सपदि सिंधु एहिं पारा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi karat saprem bicārā
āyau sapadi siṃdhu ehiṃ pārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कपिन्ह बिभीषनु आवत देखा ।
जाना कोउ रिपु दूत बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
kapinh bibhīṣanu āvat dekhā
jānā kou ripu dūt biseṣā

verses.sa:
ताहि राखि कपीस पहिं आए ।
समाचार सब ताहि सुनाए ॥
verses.tr:
tāhi rākhi kapīs pahiṃ āe
samācār sab tāhi sunāe

verses.sa:
कह सुग्रीव सुनहु रघुराई ।
आवा मिलन दसानन भाई ॥
verses.tr:
kah sugrīv sunahu raghurāī
āvā milan dasānan bhāī

verses.sa:
कह प्रभु सखा बूझिऐ काहा ।
कहइ कपीस सुनहु नरनाहा ॥
verses.tr:
kah prabhu sakhā būjhiai kāhā
kahai kapīs sunahu naranāhā

verses.sa:
जानि न जाइ निसाचर माया ।
कामरूप केहि कारन आया ॥
verses.tr:
jāni na jāi nisācar māyā
kāmarūp kehi kāran āyā

verses.sa:
भेद हमार लेन सठ आवा ।
राखिअ बाँधि मोहि अस भावा ॥
verses.tr:
bhed hamār len saṭh āvā
rākhia bām̐dhi mohi as bhāvā

verses.sa:
सखा नीति तुम्ह नीकि बिचारी ।
मम पन सरनागत भयहारी ॥
verses.tr:
sakhā nīti tumh nīki bicārī
mam pan saranāgat bhayahārī

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन हरष हनुमाना ।
सरनागत बच्छल भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan haraṣ hanumānā
saranāgat bacchal bhagavānā

verses.sa:
सरनागत कहुँ जे तजहिं निज अनहित अनुमानि ।
ते नर पावँर पापमय तिन्हहि बिलोकत हानि ॥
verses.tr:
saranāgat kahum̐ je tajahiṃ nij anahit anumāni
te nar pāvam̐r pāpamaya tinhahi bilokat hāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With such loving fancies to occupy his mind, he quickly arrived on this side the ocean. When the monkeys saw Vibhishan coming, they took him to be some special envoy. So they stopt him and went to their chief and told him all the circumstances. Said Sugriva: “Hearken, Raghurai;

Ravan’s brother has come to see you.” The lord replied: “What do you advise, friend?” The monkey king rejoined: “Mark my words, Sire; the craft of these demons is past all telling. Why should he come thus of his own accord? The villain’s object is to spy out our secrets. My idea is that we ought to keep him prisoner.” Friend, you have reasoned'with much wordly wisdom; but I have a vow to befriend all suppliants. “Hanuman was delighted to hear these words from the Lord, the God who shows compassion on all who flee to him.
“The men who abandon a suppliant, from suspicion that he may be an enemy, are vile and criminal, and misfortune will keep her eye upon them.

sections.label: Doha 44
sections.name: उभय भाँति तेहि आनहु हँसि कह कृपानिकेत

verses.sa:
कोटि बिप्र बध लागहिं जाहू ।
आएँ सरन तजउँ नहिं ताहू ॥
verses.tr:
koṭi bipr badh lāgahiṃ jāhū
āem̐ saran tajaum̐ nahiṃ tāhū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सनमुख होइ जीव मोहि जबहीं ।
जन्म कोटि अघ नासहिं तबहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sanamukh hoi jīv mohi jabahīṃ
janm koṭi agh nāsahiṃ tabahīṃ

verses.sa:
पापवंत कर सहज सुभाऊ ।
भजनु मोर तेहि भाव न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
pāpavaṃt kar sahaj subhāū
bhajanu mor tehi bhāv na kāū

verses.sa:
जौं पै दुष्टहदय सोइ होई ।
मोरें सनमुख आव कि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ pai duṣṭahadaya soi hoī
moreṃ sanamukh āv ki soī

verses.sa:
निर्मल मन जन सो मोहि पावा ।
मोहि कपट छल छिद्र न भावा ॥
verses.tr:
nirmal man jan so mohi pāvā
mohi kapaṭ chal chidr na bhāvā

verses.sa:
भेद लेन पठवा दससीसा ।
तबहुँ न कछु भय हानि कपीसा ॥
verses.tr:
bhed len paṭhavā dasasīsā
tabahum̐ na kachu bhaya hāni kapīsā

verses.sa:
जग महुँ सखा निसाचर जेते ।
लछिमनु हनइ निमिष महुँ तेते ॥
verses.tr:
jag mahum̐ sakhā nisācar jete
lachimanu hanai nimiṣ mahum̐ tete

verses.sa:
जौं सभीत आवा सरनाई ।
रखिहउँ ताहि प्रान की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ sabhīt āvā saranāī
rakhihaum̐ tāhi prān kī nāī

verses.sa:
उभय भाँति तेहि आनहु हँसि कह कृपानिकेत ।
जय कृपाल कहि चले अंगद हनू समेत ॥
verses.tr:
ubhaya bhām̐ti tehi ānahu ham̐si kah kṛpāniket
jaya kṛpāl kahi cale aṃgad hanū samet
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I would not abandon any one who had fled to me for protection, even though he had been guilty of the murder of u million Brahmans. Directly any creature appears before me, I bolt out the sins of all his past lives. No one who is essentially wicked can delight in my service; if he is really bad at heart, bow can he come into my presence? Only a man of pure soul can find me; I take no pleasure in hypocrisy, deceit and vice. Ravan may have sent him as a spy; but even so, O king, we need not fear any loss. All the demons, my friend, that the whole world contains, Lakshman could rout in a single moment. If he has come out of fear, to sue for mercy, I will protect him as I would my own life.
In either case bring him here.” Thus spake the Allmerciful with a smile. “Glory to the lord of mercy” cried

sections.label: Doha 45
sections.name: श्रवन सुजसु सुनि आयउँ प्रभु भंजन भव भीर

verses.sa:
सादर तेहि आगें करि बानर ।
चले जहाँ रघुपति करुनाकर ॥
verses.tr:
sādar tehi āgeṃ kari bānar
cale jahām̐ raghupati karunākar
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दूरिहि ते देखे द्वौ भ्राता ।
नयनानंद दान के दाता ॥
verses.tr:
dūrihi te dekhe dvau bhrātā
nayanānaṃd dān ke dātā

verses.sa:
बहुरि राम छबिधाम बिलोकी ।
रहेउ ठटुकि एकटक पल रोकी ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri rām chabidhām bilokī
raheu ṭhaṭuki ekaṭak pal rokī

verses.sa:
भुज प्रलंब कंजारुन लोचन ।
स्यामल गात प्रनत भय मोचन ॥
verses.tr:
bhuj pralaṃb kaṃjārun locan
syāmal gāt pranat bhaya mocan

verses.sa:
सिंघ कंध आयत उर सोहा ।
आनन अमित मदन मन मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
siṃgh kaṃdh āyat ur sohā
ānan amit madan man mohā

verses.sa:
नयन नीर पुलकित अति गाता ।
मन धरि धीर कही मृदु बाता ॥
verses.tr:
nayan nīr pulakit ati gātā
man dhari dhīr kahī mṛdu bātā

verses.sa:
नाथ दसानन कर मैं भ्राता ।
निसिचर बंस जनम सुरत्राता ॥
verses.tr:
nāth dasānan kar maiṃ bhrātā
nisicar baṃs janam suratrātā

verses.sa:
सहज पापप्रिय तामस देहा ।
जथा उलूकहि तम पर नेहा ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj pāpapriya tāmas dehā
jathā ulūkahi tam par nehā

verses.sa:
श्रवन सुजसु सुनि आयउँ प्रभु भंजन भव भीर ।
त्राहि त्राहि आरति हरन सरन सुखद रघुबीर ॥
verses.tr:
śravan sujasu suni āyaum̐ prabhu bhaṃjan bhav bhīr
trāhi trāhi ārati haran saran sukhad raghubīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: the monkey as he went, taking with him Angad and Hanuman. Chaupdi.

The monkeys respectfully escorted him into the presence of the all-merciful Rama. He beheld from a distance the two brothers, the delight of all men’s eyes, the givers of every blessing; then looking again upon Rama’s perfect beauty, he stood stock still, with all his gaze intently fixed upon the long arms, the lotus eyes and dark-hued body of the suppliant’s friend, his lion-like shoulders and magnificent broad chest and his charming face, that would ravish the soul of Kamadeva himself. With streaming eyes and trembling limbs he at last made bold to speak in accents mild. ‘“ My lord, I am Ravan’s brother; Champion of heaven, I have been born of demon race, with a savage temperament, as naturally prone to evil as an owl is partial to the night.
I have heard with my ears of your glory and have come; O my lord, save me, save me; you who are the deliverer from all life’s troubles, the remover of distress, the friend of the suppliant, Raghubir.

sections.label: Doha 46
sections.name: तब लगि कुसल न जीव कहुँ सपनेहुँ मन बिश्राम

verses.sa:
अस कहि करत दंडवत देखा ।
तुरत उठे प्रभु हरष बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi karat daṃḍavat dekhā
turat uṭhe prabhu haraṣ biseṣā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दीन बचन सुनि प्रभु मन भावा ।
भुज बिसाल गहि हृदयँ लगावा ॥
verses.tr:
dīn bacan suni prabhu man bhāvā
bhuj bisāl gahi hṛdayam̐ lagāvā

verses.sa:
अनुज सहित मिलि ढिग बैठारी ।
बोले बचन भगत भयहारी ॥
verses.tr:
anuj sahit mili ḍhig baiṭhārī
bole bacan bhagat bhayahārī

verses.sa:
कहु लंकेस सहित परिवारा ।
कुसल कुठाहर बास तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
kahu laṃkes sahit parivārā
kusal kuṭhāhar bās tumhārā

verses.sa:
खल मंडलीं बसहु दिनु राती ।
सखा धरम निबहइ केहि भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
khal maṃḍalīṃ basahu dinu rātī
sakhā dharam nibahai kehi bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
मैं जानउँ तुम्हारि सब रीती ।
अति नय निपुन न भाव अनीती ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ jānaum̐ tumhāri sab rītī
ati naya nipun na bhāv anītī

verses.sa:
बरु भल बास नरक कर ताता ।
दुष्ट संग जनि देइ बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
baru bhal bās narak kar tātā
duṣṭ saṃg jani dei bidhātā

verses.sa:
अब पद देखि कुसल रघुराया ।
जौं तुम्ह कीन्ह जानि जन दाया ॥
verses.tr:
ab pad dekhi kusal raghurāyā
jauṃ tumh kīnh jāni jan dāyā

verses.sa:
तब लगि कुसल न जीव कहुँ सपनेहुँ मन बिश्राम ।
जब लगि भजत न राम कहुँ सोक धाम तजि काम ॥
verses.tr:
tab lagi kusal na jīv kahum̐ sapanehum̐ man biśrām
jab lagi bhajat na rām kahum̐ sok dhām taji kām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: So saying he prostrated himself; but at the sight the Lord arose in haste with much delight, being pleased to hear his humble address, and took him in his mighty arms and clasped him to his breast; then with his brother seated him by his side, and to calm his votary’s fears spake thus: * Tell me, prince of Lanka, is it all well with you and your family? Your home is in an ill place. How, my friend, can one practise the duties of religion, when encompassed day and night by wicked men I know all your circumstances, your proficiency in virtue, your aversion to evil. God keep us from evil communications:’ twere better, my son, to live in hell.’ ‘Now that I have seen your feet, O Rama, it is all well with me, since you have recognized me as one of your worshippers and have shown mercy upon me.
No creature can be happy, or even dream of rest to his soul, till he worship Rama, after forswearing lust, that fountain of remorse.

sections.label: Doha 47
sections.name: -अहोभाग्य मम अमित अति राम कृपा सुख पुंज

verses.sa:
तब लगि हृदयँ बसत खल नाना ।
लोभ मोह मच्छर मद माना ॥
verses.tr:
tab lagi hṛdayam̐ basat khal nānā
lobh moh macchar mad mānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जब लगि उर न बसत रघुनाथा ।
धरें चाप सायक कटि भाथा ॥
verses.tr:
jab lagi ur na basat raghunāthā
dhareṃ cāp sāyak kaṭi bhāthā

verses.sa:
ममता तरुन तमी अँधिआरी ।
राग द्वेष उलूक सुखकारी ॥
verses.tr:
mamatā tarun tamī am̐dhiārī
rāg dveṣ ulūk sukhakārī

verses.sa:
तब लगि बसति जीव मन माहीं ।
जब लगि प्रभु प्रताप रबि नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tab lagi basati jīv man māhīṃ
jab lagi prabhu pratāp rabi nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
अब मैं कुसल मिटे भय भारे ।
देखि राम पद कमल तुम्हारे ॥
verses.tr:
ab maiṃ kusal miṭe bhaya bhāre
dekhi rām pad kamal tumhāre

verses.sa:
तुम्ह कृपाल जा पर अनुकूला ।
ताहि न ब्याप त्रिबिध भव सूला ॥
verses.tr:
tumh kṛpāl jā par anukūlā
tāhi na byāp tribidh bhav sūlā

verses.sa:
मैं निसिचर अति अधम सुभाऊ ।
सुभ आचरनु कीन्ह नहिं काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ nisicar ati adham subhāū
subh ācaranu kīnh nahiṃ kāū

verses.sa:
जासु रूप मुनि ध्यान न आवा ।
तेहिं प्रभु हरषि हृदयँ मोहि लावा ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu rūp muni dhyān na āvā
tehiṃ prabhu haraṣi hṛdayam̐ mohi lāvā

verses.sa:
-अहोभाग्य मम अमित अति राम कृपा सुख पुंज ।
देखेउँ नयन बिरंचि सिब सेब्य जुगल पद कंज ॥
verses.tr:
-ahobhāgya mam amit ati rām kṛpā sukh puṃj
dekheum̐ nayan biraṃci sib sebya jugal pad kaṃj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘So long as the heart is peopled by that villainous crew, avarice, sensuality, selfishness, arrogance and pride, there iso room there for Raghunath, with his bow and arrows and quiver by his side. The intensely dark night of selfishness, 80 agreeable to the owl-like passions of love and hate, abides in the soul only until the rising of the sun like lord. Now I am well, and all my fears are over, in that I have b held yonr lotus feet. None of the threefold torments of life has any effect upon him, to whom you in your mercy show favour. Iamademon, utterly vile of nature, who have never observed any pious practices, and yet the lord, to whose vision even the saints have not attained, for all their profound meditation has been pleased to take me to his heart.
‘Surely I am blessed beyond measure, and RAma's grace is most beneficent, io that I behold with my eyes those lotus feet, which even Brahma and Siva adore,”

sections.label: Doha 48
sections.name: सगुन उपासक परहित निरत नीति दृढ़ नेम

verses.sa:
सुनहु सखा निज कहउँ सुभाऊ ।
जान भुसुंडि संभु गिरिजाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu sakhā nij kahaum̐ subhāū
jān bhusuṃḍi saṃbhu girijāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जौं नर होइ चराचर द्रोही ।
आवे सभय सरन तकि मोही ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ nar hoi carācar drohī
āve sabhaya saran taki mohī

verses.sa:
तजि मद मोह कपट छल नाना ।
करउँ सद्य तेहि साधु समाना ॥
verses.tr:
taji mad moh kapaṭ chal nānā
karaum̐ sadya tehi sādhu samānā

verses.sa:
जननी जनक बंधु सुत दारा ।
तनु धनु भवन सुह्रद परिवारा ॥
verses.tr:
jananī janak baṃdhu sut dārā
tanu dhanu bhavan suhrad parivārā

verses.sa:
सब कै ममता ताग बटोरी ।
मम पद मनहि बाँध बरि डोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sab kai mamatā tāg baṭorī
mam pad manahi bām̐dh bari ḍorī

verses.sa:
समदरसी इच्छा कछु नाहीं ।
हरष सोक भय नहिं मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
samadarasī icchā kachu nāhīṃ
haraṣ sok bhaya nahiṃ man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
अस सज्जन मम उर बस कैसें ।
लोभी हृदयँ बसइ धनु जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
as sajjan mam ur bas kaiseṃ
lobhī hṛdayam̐ basai dhanu jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
तुम्ह सारिखे संत प्रिय मोरें ।
धरउँ देह नहिं आन निहोरें ॥
verses.tr:
tumh sārikhe saṃt priya moreṃ
dharaum̐ deh nahiṃ ān nihoreṃ

verses.sa:
सगुन उपासक परहित निरत नीति दृढ़ नेम ।
ते नर प्रान समान मम जिन्ह कें द्विज पद प्रेम ॥
verses.tr:
sagun upāsak parahit nirat nīti dṛr̤h nem
te nar prān samān mam jinh keṃ dvij pad prem
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Hearken, friend; I will declare to you my characteristics, as known by Bhusundi, Sambhu and Uma. If a man who has been the curse of the whole world comes trembling and looks to me for protection, if he abjures all his pride and sensuality without guile or subterfuge; | make him at once like one of the saints. Father and mother; kinsfolk, children and wife; life and property; home, friends and establishment; in short, every object of natural affection is gathered up as the strands of a rope wherewith to attach his soul to my feet. He regards all things as alike, without any preference, and with a soul unmoved either by joy, sorrow, or fear. A saint like this is as fixed in my soul as money is in the heart of a miser. Good men like you are my friends, and it is only for their benefit that I have become incarnate.
“Virtuonsand devoted believers, who are steadfast in aprightness strict in pious observances, and who love and revere Br^hmans, are the men whom I regard as my own soul.

sections.label: Doha 49
sections.name: रावन क्रोध अनल निज स्वास समीर प्रचंड

verses.sa:
सुनु लंकेस सकल गुन तोरें ।
तातें तुम्ह अतिसय प्रिय मोरें ॥
verses.tr:
sunu laṃkes sakal gun toreṃ
tāteṃ tumh atisaya priya moreṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम बचन सुनि बानर जूथा ।
सकल कहहिं जय कृपा बरूथा ॥
verses.tr:
rām bacan suni bānar jūthā
sakal kahahiṃ jaya kṛpā barūthā

verses.sa:
सुनत बिभीषनु प्रभु कै बानी ।
नहिं अघात श्रवनामृत जानी ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bibhīṣanu prabhu kai bānī
nahiṃ aghāt śravanāmṛt jānī

verses.sa:
पद अंबुज गहि बारहिं बारा ।
हृदयँ समात न प्रेमु अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
pad aṃbuj gahi bārahiṃ bārā
hṛdayam̐ samāt na premu apārā

verses.sa:
सुनहु देव सचराचर स्वामी ।
प्रनतपाल उर अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu dev sacarācar svāmī
pranatapāl ur aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
उर कछु प्रथम बासना रही ।
प्रभु पद प्रीति सरित सो बही ॥
verses.tr:
ur kachu pratham bāsanā rahī
prabhu pad prīti sarit so bahī

verses.sa:
अब कृपाल निज भगति पावनी ।
देहु सदा सिव मन भावनी ॥
verses.tr:
ab kṛpāl nij bhagati pāvanī
dehu sadā siv man bhāvanī

verses.sa:
एवमस्तु कहि प्रभु रनधीरा ।
मागा तुरत सिंधु कर नीरा ॥
verses.tr:
evamastu kahi prabhu ranadhīrā
māgā turat siṃdhu kar nīrā

verses.sa:
जदपि सखा तव इच्छा नाहीं ।
मोर दरसु अमोघ जग माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi sakhā tav icchā nāhīṃ
mor darasu amogh jag māhīṃ

verses.sa:
अस कहि राम तिलक तेहि सारा ।
सुमन बृष्टि नभ भई अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi rām tilak tehi sārā
suman bṛṣṭi nabh bhaī apārā

verses.sa:
रावन क्रोध अनल निज स्वास समीर प्रचंड ।
जरत बिभीषनु राखेउ दीन्हेहु राजु अखंड ॥
verses.tr:
rāvan krodh anal nij svās samīr pracaṃḍ
jarat bibhīṣanu rākheu dīnhehu rāju akhaṃḍ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
जो संपति सिव रावनहि दीन्हि दिएँ दस माथ ।
सोइ संपदा बिभीषनहि सकुचि दीन्ह रघुनाथ ॥
verses.tr:
jo saṃpati siv rāvanahi dīnhi diem̐ das māth
soi saṃpadā bibhīṣanahi sakuci dīnh raghunāth

trans: “‘ Hearken, Prince of Lanka; all these good qualities are yours, and you are therefore very dear to me.” On hearing Rama’s speech, all the assembled monkeys exclaimed, ‘Glory to the All-merciful!’ But Vibhishan, on hearing such ambrosial sounds, could not contain himself: time after time he clasped his lotus feet, his heart bursting with boundless joy. “Hearken, my God, lord of all creation, friend of the suppliant, reader of men’s thoughts; I had at first another wish in my mind; but devotion to my lord’s feet has come upon me like a torrent and swept it away: now in your mercy grant me such pure faith as that which

ever gladdens Siva’s soul.” ‘So be it,’ said the Lord, the valiant in fight, and then at once called for water from the sea. ‘It was not part of your wish, friend, but the sight of me brings reward with it all over the world.” So saying Rama marked his forehead with the royal tilak: an infinite shower of flowers rained from heaven.

Thos did Raghunath protect the humble Vibhishan from Ravan’s fiery wrath, fanned by the strong.blast of his breath, and gave him secure dominion and all the good fortune which Siva had formerly bestowed upon the tenheaded

sections.label: Doha 50
sections.name: प्रभु तुम्हार कुलगुर जलधि कहिहि उपाय बिचारि

verses.sa:
अस प्रभु छाड़ि भजहिं जे आना ।
ते नर पसु बिनु पूँछ बिषाना ॥
verses.tr:
as prabhu chār̤i bhajahiṃ je ānā
te nar pasu binu pūm̐ch biṣānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
निज जन जानि ताहि अपनावा ।
प्रभु सुभाव कपि कुल मन भावा ॥
verses.tr:
nij jan jāni tāhi apanāvā
prabhu subhāv kapi kul man bhāvā

verses.sa:
पुनि सर्बग्य सर्ब उर बासी ।
सर्बरूप सब रहित उदासी ॥
verses.tr:
puni sarbagya sarb ur bāsī
sarbarūp sab rahit udāsī

verses.sa:
बोले बचन नीति प्रतिपालक ।
कारन मनुज दनुज कुल घालक ॥
verses.tr:
bole bacan nīti pratipālak
kāran manuj danuj kul ghālak

verses.sa:
सुनु कपीस लंकापति बीरा ।
केहि बिधि तरिअ जलधि गंभीरा ॥
verses.tr:
sunu kapīs laṃkāpati bīrā
kehi bidhi taria jaladhi gaṃbhīrā

verses.sa:
संकुल मकर उरग झष जाती ।
अति अगाध दुस्तर सब भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
saṃkul makar urag jhaṣ jātī
ati agādh dustar sab bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
कह लंकेस सुनहु रघुनायक ।
कोटि सिंधु सोषक तव सायक ॥
verses.tr:
kah laṃkes sunahu raghunāyak
koṭi siṃdhu soṣak tav sāyak

verses.sa:
जद्यपि तदपि नीति असि गाई ।
बिनय करिअ सागर सन जाई ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi tadapi nīti asi gāī
binaya karia sāgar san jāī

verses.sa:
प्रभु तुम्हार कुलगुर जलधि कहिहि उपाय बिचारि ।
बिनु प्रयास सागर तरिहि सकल भालु कपि धारि ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu tumhār kulagur jaladhi kahihi upāya bicāri
binu prayās sāgar tarihi sakal bhālu kapi dhāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Men who forsake such a lord to worship any other are mere beasts without the tails and horns. All the monkeys were charmed with the Lord's amiability, who had recognized a servant and claimed him for his own. Then the Allwise, who dwelleth in the hearts of all, assuming any form at will, though himself formless and passionless, the champion of religion, the friend of men, and the destroyer of all the demon race, spoke and said: " Hearken monkey-king, valiant monarch of Lank^; how are we to cross the deep ocean, full of alligators, serpents and different kinds of sea monsters, of fathomless profundity and absolutely impassible." Vibhishan replied: " Hearken, Rahu-ndyak; your arrows could burn up a thousand seas, but still it would be better policy to go and make petition to the god
For being your family priest.) my lord, he will take thought and suggest some scheme, by which the whole host of bears and monkeys may cross the deep without any trouble.”

sections.label: Doha 51
sections.name: सकल चरित तिन्ह देखे धरें कपट कपि देह

verses.sa:
सखा कही तुम्ह नीकि उपाई ।
करिअ दैव जौं होइ सहाई ॥
verses.tr:
sakhā kahī tumh nīki upāī
karia daiv jauṃ hoi sahāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मंत्र न यह लछिमन मन भावा ।
राम बचन सुनि अति दुख पावा ॥
verses.tr:
maṃtr na yah lachiman man bhāvā
rām bacan suni ati dukh pāvā

verses.sa:
नाथ दैव कर कवन भरोसा ।
सोषिअ सिंधु करिअ मन रोसा ॥
verses.tr:
nāth daiv kar kavan bharosā
soṣia siṃdhu karia man rosā

verses.sa:
कादर मन कहुँ एक अधारा ।
दैव दैव आलसी पुकारा ॥
verses.tr:
kādar man kahum̐ ek adhārā
daiv daiv ālasī pukārā

verses.sa:
सुनत बिहसि बोले रघुबीरा ।
ऐसेहिं करब धरहु मन धीरा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bihasi bole raghubīrā
aisehiṃ karab dharahu man dhīrā

verses.sa:
अस कहि प्रभु अनुजहि समुझाई ।
सिंधु समीप गए रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi prabhu anujahi samujhāī
siṃdhu samīp gae raghurāī

verses.sa:
प्रथम प्रनाम कीन्ह सिरु नाई ।
बैठे पुनि तट दर्भ डसाई ॥
verses.tr:
pratham pranām kīnh siru nāī
baiṭhe puni taṭ darbh ḍasāī

verses.sa:
जबहिं बिभीषन प्रभु पहिं आए ।
पाछें रावन दूत पठाए ॥
verses.tr:
jabahiṃ bibhīṣan prabhu pahiṃ āe
pācheṃ rāvan dūt paṭhāe

verses.sa:
सकल चरित तिन्ह देखे धरें कपट कपि देह ।
प्रभु गुन हृदयँ सराहहिं सरनागत पर नेह ॥
verses.tr:
sakal carit tinh dekhe dhareṃ kapaṭ kapi deh
prabhu gun hṛdayam̐ sarāhahiṃ saranāgat par neh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘« Friend, you have suggested a good idea; Let us try it and may fortune be with us.” This invocation did not please Lakshman; he was noch annoyed at Rama's words. * Why trust fortune, my lord? give vent to your indignation and dry up the ocean. It is the one resource of a coward in soul

; ocean was dug, which is thence called Sagar, was one of Rama's ancestors, ip to sit still and pray fortune to help him.” Raghubir laughed to hear this and said: “‘ [ shall do it all the same; but never you mind.” So saying he went to the shore of the salt sea and there took his seat on grass that he had strewn. Now after Vibhishan had joined Rama, Ravan sent spies of his own,
Who disguised themselves as monkeys, and so saw all that was going‘on. In their profound admiration of the Lord’s generosity and his tenderness to suppliants.

sections.label: Doha 52
sections.name: कहेहु मुखागर मूढ़ सन मम संदेसु उदार

verses.sa:
प्रगट बखानहिं राम सुभाऊ ।
अति सप्रेम गा बिसरि दुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
pragaṭ bakhānahiṃ rām subhāū
ati saprem gā bisari durāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रिपु के दूत कपिन्ह तब जाने ।
सकल बाँधि कपीस पहिं आने ॥
verses.tr:
ripu ke dūt kapinh tab jāne
sakal bām̐dhi kapīs pahiṃ āne

verses.sa:
कह सुग्रीव सुनहु सब बानर ।
अंग भंग करि पठवहु निसिचर ॥
verses.tr:
kah sugrīv sunahu sab bānar
aṃg bhaṃg kari paṭhavahu nisicar

verses.sa:
सुनि सुग्रीव बचन कपि धाए ।
बाँधि कटक चहु पास फिराए ॥
verses.tr:
suni sugrīv bacan kapi dhāe
bām̐dhi kaṭak cahu pās phirāe

verses.sa:
बहु प्रकार मारन कपि लागे ।
दीन पुकारत तदपि न त्यागे ॥
verses.tr:
bahu prakār māran kapi lāge
dīn pukārat tadapi na tyāge

verses.sa:
जो हमार हर नासा काना ।
तेहि कोसलाधीस कै आना ॥
verses.tr:
jo hamār har nāsā kānā
tehi kosalādhīs kai ānā

verses.sa:
सुनि लछिमन सब निकट बोलाए ।
दया लागि हँसि तुरत छोडाए ॥
verses.tr:
suni lachiman sab nikaṭ bolāe
dayā lāgi ham̐si turat choḍāe

verses.sa:
रावन कर दीजहु यह पाती ।
लछिमन बचन बाचु कुलघाती ॥
verses.tr:
rāvan kar dījahu yah pātī
lachiman bacan bācu kulaghātī

verses.sa:
कहेहु मुखागर मूढ़ सन मम संदेसु उदार ।
सीता देइ मिलेहु न त आवा काल तुम्हार ॥
verses.tr:
kahehu mukhāgar mūr̤h san mam saṃdesu udār
sītā dei milehu na ta āvā kāl tumhār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: They loudly extolled his magnanimity and in the intensity of their devotion forgot their disguise, When the monkeys perceived them to be spies from the enemy, they seized them and took them to their chief. Said Sugriva. ** Hearken, all you monkeys: just mutilate them and let them go.” On receiving this command, the monkeys ran and paraded them io bonds all through the camp, ill-treating them in every possible way and refusing to Let them go for all their prayers for mercy, till they cried: ‘We adjure you by Rama not to rob us of our nose and ears.’ When Lakshman heard this, he called them all to him, and, being moved with compassion, smiled and had them at once set free: ‘Give this missive into Ravan’s hands” and say ‘Read, destroyer of your race, what Lakshman says.
Tell the fool also by word of mouth my emphatic command—' Surrender Sita and submit yourself, or it will be your death.’

sections.label: Doha 53
sections.name: -की भइ भेंट कि फिरि गए श्रवन सुजसु सुनि मोर

verses.sa:
तुरत नाइ लछिमन पद माथा ।
चले दूत बरनत गुन गाथा ॥
verses.tr:
turat nāi lachiman pad māthā
cale dūt baranat gun gāthā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहत राम जसु लंकाँ आए ।
रावन चरन सीस तिन्ह नाए ॥
verses.tr:
kahat rām jasu laṃkām̐ āe
rāvan caran sīs tinh nāe

verses.sa:
बिहसि दसानन पूँछी बाता ।
कहसि न सुक आपनि कुसलाता ॥
verses.tr:
bihasi dasānan pūm̐chī bātā
kahasi na suk āpani kusalātā

verses.sa:
पुनि कहु खबरि बिभीषन केरी ।
जाहि मृत्यु आई अति नेरी ॥
verses.tr:
puni kahu khabari bibhīṣan kerī
jāhi mṛtyu āī ati nerī

verses.sa:
करत राज लंका सठ त्यागी ।
होइहि जब कर कीट अभागी ॥
verses.tr:
karat rāj laṃkā saṭh tyāgī
hoihi jab kar kīṭ abhāgī

verses.sa:
पुनि कहु भालु कीस कटकाई ।
कठिन काल प्रेरित चलि आई ॥
verses.tr:
puni kahu bhālu kīs kaṭakāī
kaṭhin kāl prerit cali āī

verses.sa:
जिन्ह के जीवन कर रखवारा ।
भयउ मृदुल चित सिंधु बिचारा ॥
verses.tr:
jinh ke jīvan kar rakhavārā
bhayau mṛdul cit siṃdhu bicārā

verses.sa:
कहु तपसिन्ह कै बात बहोरी ।
जिन्ह के हृदयँ त्रास अति मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kahu tapasinh kai bāt bahorī
jinh ke hṛdayam̐ trās ati morī

verses.sa:
-की भइ भेंट कि फिरि गए श्रवन सुजसु सुनि मोर ।
कहसि न रिपु दल तेज बल बहुत चकित चित तोर ॥
verses.tr:
-kī bhai bheṃṭ ki phiri gae śravan sujasu suni mor
kahasi na ripu dal tej bal bahut cakit cit tor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The spies bowed the head at Lakshman’s feet and set out at once, praising his generosity. Still repeating Rama's praises, they arrived at Lanka and _ prostrated themselves before Ravan, The Ten-headed with a smile asked them the news: “Tell me, Suka, I pray, of your own welfare, and then let me hear about Vibhishan, to whom death has drawn very nigh. The fool) left Lanka where he wasa king; but now the wretched weevil must be crushed with the wheat. Tell me next what force these bears and monkeys muster, who have come hear by command of their evil destiny though the poor old sea has been
soft-hearted enough to spare their lives. Tell me finally about the hermits, whose soul trembles for fear of me.
“Did he meet you as a suppliant, or did he take to flight on hearing the report of my renown Will you tell me nothing about the enemy’s might and magnificence? Your wits seem utterly dazed.”

sections.label: Doha 54
sections.name: द्विबिद मयंद नील नल अंगद गद बिकटासि

verses.sa:
नाथ कृपा करि पूँछेहु जैसें ।
मानहु कहा क्रोध तजि तैसें ॥
verses.tr:
nāth kṛpā kari pūm̐chehu jaiseṃ
mānahu kahā krodh taji taiseṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मिला जाइ जब अनुज तुम्हारा ।
जातहिं राम तिलक तेहि सारा ॥
verses.tr:
milā jāi jab anuj tumhārā
jātahiṃ rām tilak tehi sārā

verses.sa:
रावन दूत हमहि सुनि काना ।
कपिन्ह बाँधि दीन्हे दुख नाना ॥
verses.tr:
rāvan dūt hamahi suni kānā
kapinh bām̐dhi dīnhe dukh nānā

verses.sa:
श्रवन नासिका काटै लागे ।
राम सपथ दीन्हे हम त्यागे ॥
verses.tr:
śravan nāsikā kāṭai lāge
rām sapath dīnhe ham tyāge

verses.sa:
पूँछिहु नाथ राम कटकाई ।
बदन कोटि सत बरनि न जाई ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐chihu nāth rām kaṭakāī
badan koṭi sat barani na jāī

verses.sa:
नाना बरन भालु कपि धारी ।
बिकटानन बिसाल भयकारी ॥
verses.tr:
nānā baran bhālu kapi dhārī
bikaṭānan bisāl bhayakārī

verses.sa:
जेहिं पुर दहेउ हतेउ सुत तोरा ।
सकल कपिन्ह महँ तेहि बलु थोरा ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ pur daheu hateu sut torā
sakal kapinh maham̐ tehi balu thorā

verses.sa:
अमित नाम भट कठिन कराला ।
अमित नाग बल बिपुल बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
amit nām bhaṭ kaṭhin karālā
amit nāg bal bipul bisālā

verses.sa:
द्विबिद मयंद नील नल अंगद गद बिकटासि ।
दधिमुख केहरि निसठ सठ जामवंत बलरासि ॥
verses.tr:
dvibid mayaṃd nīl nal aṃgad gad bikaṭāsi
dadhimukh kehari nisaṭh saṭh jāmavaṃt balarāsi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Of your grace, my lord, be not wroth, but take a blunt reply to a blunt question. As soon as your younger brother joined him, Rama bestowed upon him the mark of sovereignty. The monkeys, who had heard that we were your spies, put us in bonds and abused us shamefully. They were about to cut off our ears and nose, when we invoked the name of Ramayana they let us go. You ask. my lord, of Rama’s army; a myriad tongues would fail to tell it: such a host of bears and monkeys of diverse hue and gruesome visage, huge and terrible—the one who set fire to the city and slew your son is the very weakest of them all— champions with innumerable names, fierce and unyielding monsters of vast bulk, with the strength of unnumbered elephants.

sections.label: Doha 55
sections.name: -सहज सूर कपि भालु सब पुनि सिर पर प्रभु राम

verses.sa:
ए कपि सब सुग्रीव समाना ।
इन्ह सम कोटिन्ह गनइ को नाना ॥
verses.tr:
e kapi sab sugrīv samānā
inh sam koṭinh ganai ko nānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम कृपाँ अतुलित बल तिन्हहीं ।
तृन समान त्रेलोकहि गनहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām kṛpām̐ atulit bal tinhahīṃ
tṛn samān trelokahi ganahīṃ

verses.sa:
अस मैं सुना श्रवन दसकंधर ।
पदुम अठारह जूथप बंदर ॥
verses.tr:
as maiṃ sunā śravan dasakaṃdhar
padum aṭhārah jūthap baṃdar

verses.sa:
नाथ कटक महँ सो कपि नाहीं ।
जो न तुम्हहि जीतै रन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nāth kaṭak maham̐ so kapi nāhīṃ
jo na tumhahi jītai ran māhīṃ

verses.sa:
परम क्रोध मीजहिं सब हाथा ।
आयसु पै न देहिं रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
param krodh mījahiṃ sab hāthā
āyasu pai na dehiṃ raghunāthā

verses.sa:
सोषहिं सिंधु सहित झष ब्याला ।
पूरहीं न त भरि कुधर बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
soṣahiṃ siṃdhu sahit jhaṣ byālā
pūrahīṃ na ta bhari kudhar bisālā

verses.sa:
मर्दि गर्द मिलवहिं दससीसा ।
ऐसेइ बचन कहहिं सब कीसा ॥
verses.tr:
mardi gard milavahiṃ dasasīsā
aisei bacan kahahiṃ sab kīsā

verses.sa:
गर्जहिं तर्जहिं सहज असंका ।
मानहु ग्रसन चहत हहिं लंका ॥
verses.tr:
garjahiṃ tarjahiṃ sahaj asaṃkā
mānahu grasan cahat hahiṃ laṃkā

verses.sa:
-सहज सूर कपि भालु सब पुनि सिर पर प्रभु राम ।
रावन काल कोटि कहु जीति सकहिं संग्राम ॥
verses.tr:
-sahaj sūr kapi bhālu sab puni sir par prabhu rām
rāvan kāl koṭi kahu jīti sakahiṃ saṃgrām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Kuch of these monkeys is equal to Sugriva, and who could count all the myriads like them By Rema’s favour their strength is unbounded; they reckon the three spheres of creation as of no more account than a blade of grass. I have heard say, O Ravan, that the monkey chiefs number eighteen thousand billions; and in the whole of the army, my lord, there is not a single monkey who would not conquer you in battle. ‘They are all wringing their hands io excess of passion: ‘Why does not Rama give us some order, either to swallow the ocean with all its fish and serpents, or at least to fill it up-with piles of trees and mighty mountains, and then crush RAvan and Lay him now in the dust,’ Thisis the language that all the monkeys hold.
Utterly devoid of fear, they shout and leap about as if they would make Lanka a mere mouthful.
‘C All the bears and monkeys are born warriors, and, moreover, they have the lord Rama at their head. O Ravan, they could conquer in battle even Death himself, a myriad times over,

sections.label: Doha 56
sections.name: बातन्ह मनहि रिझाइ सठ जनि घालसि कुल खीस

verses.sa:
राम तेज बल बुधि बिपुलाई ।
सेष सहस सत सकहिं न गाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām tej bal budhi bipulāī
seṣ sahas sat sakahiṃ na gāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सक सर एक सोषि सत सागर ।
तब भ्रातहि पूँछेउ नय नागर ॥
verses.tr:
sak sar ek soṣi sat sāgar
tab bhrātahi pūm̐cheu naya nāgar

verses.sa:
तासु बचन सुनि सागर पाहीं ।
मागत पंथ कृपा मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu bacan suni sāgar pāhīṃ
māgat paṃth kṛpā man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनत बचन बिहसा दससीसा ।
जौं असि मति सहाय कृत कीसा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bacan bihasā dasasīsā
jauṃ asi mati sahāya kṛt kīsā

verses.sa:
सहज भीरु कर बचन दृढ़ाई ।
सागर सन ठानी मचलाई ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj bhīru kar bacan dṛr̤hāī
sāgar san ṭhānī macalāī

verses.sa:
मूढ़ मृषा का करसि बड़ाई ।
रिपु बल बुद्धि थाह मैं पाई ॥
verses.tr:
mūr̤h mṛṣā kā karasi bar̤āī
ripu bal buddhi thāh maiṃ pāī

verses.sa:
सचिव सभीत बिभीषन जाकें ।
बिजय बिभूति कहाँ जग ताकें ॥
verses.tr:
saciv sabhīt bibhīṣan jākeṃ
bijaya bibhūti kahām̐ jag tākeṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि खल बचन दूत रिस बाढ़ी ।
समय बिचारि पत्रिका काढ़ी ॥
verses.tr:
suni khal bacan dūt ris bār̤hī
samaya bicāri patrikā kār̤hī

verses.sa:
रामानुज दीन्ही यह पाती ।
नाथ बचाइ जुड़ावहु छाती ॥
verses.tr:
rāmānuj dīnhī yah pātī
nāth bacāi jur̤āvahu chātī

verses.sa:
बिहसि बाम कर लीन्ही रावन ।
सचिव बोलि सठ लाग बचावन ॥
verses.tr:
bihasi bām kar līnhī rāvan
saciv boli saṭh lāg bacāvan

verses.sa:
बातन्ह मनहि रिझाइ सठ जनि घालसि कुल खीस ।
राम बिरोध न उबरसि सरन बिष्नु अज ईस ॥
verses.tr:
bātanh manahi rijhāi saṭh jani ghālasi kul khīs
rām birodh na ubarasi saran biṣnu aj īs
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
की तजि मान अनुज इव प्रभु पद पंकज भृंग ।
होहि कि राम सरानल खल कुल सहित पतंग ॥
verses.tr:
kī taji mān anuj iv prabhu pad paṃkaj bhṛṃg
hohi ki rām sarānal khal kul sahit pataṃg

trans: ‘All hundred thousand Seshn^gs would fail to declare all Rama’s glory and power and wisdom. With a single shaft he could burn up a hundred seas, yet so prudent is he that he took advice of your brother and, on hearing his reply, went to the sea and humbly asked the favour of a passage.” On hearing this, the Ten-headed smiled: ‘Truly he showed as much sense then as when he took monkeys for his allies. He has put faith in the words of that arrant coward, my brother, and, like @ spoiled child, begs of ocean what he will never get. Fool, you have been extolling a mere impostor; I have sounded the depth of my enemy’s strength and skill. Where in the world could any one achieve the glory of a triumph, who had such a cowardly counsellor as Vibbishan.” The envoy waxed wroth at the wretch’s speech, and thought it a good time to produce the letter. ‘Rama's brother gave me this letter: have it read, my lord, and much good may it do you.” Ravan smiled and took it with his left hand and told his minister, the wretch, to read it out.

“Fool, submit your soul) to advice, and do not bring destruction upon all your race; you cannot escape from Rama's displeasure, even though Vishnu, Brahma and Siva be your protectors. Abandon your pride, and, like your younger brother, fly like a bee to the lotus feet of the lord, or like a moth you will be consumed in your wickedness, you and all your family, by Rama’s arrows of fire.”

sections.label: Doha 57
sections.name: बिनय न मानत जलधि जड़ गए तीन दिन बीति

verses.sa:
सुनत सभय मन मुख मुसुकाई ।
कहत दसानन सबहि सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunat sabhaya man mukh musukāī
kahat dasānan sabahi sunāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भूमि परा कर गहत अकासा ।
लघु तापस कर बाग बिलासा ॥
verses.tr:
bhūmi parā kar gahat akāsā
laghu tāpas kar bāg bilāsā

verses.sa:
कह सुक नाथ सत्य सब बानी ।
समुझहु छाड़ि प्रकृति अभिमानी ॥
verses.tr:
kah suk nāth satya sab bānī
samujhahu chār̤i prakṛti abhimānī

verses.sa:
सुनहु बचन मम परिहरि क्रोधा ।
नाथ राम सन तजहु बिरोधा ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu bacan mam parihari krodhā
nāth rām san tajahu birodhā

verses.sa:
अति कोमल रघुबीर सुभाऊ ।
जद्यपि अखिल लोक कर राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ati komal raghubīr subhāū
jadyapi akhil lok kar rāū

verses.sa:
मिलत कृपा तुम्ह पर प्रभु करिही ।
उर अपराध न एकउ धरिही ॥
verses.tr:
milat kṛpā tumh par prabhu karihī
ur aparādh na ekau dharihī

verses.sa:
जनकसुता रघुनाथहि दीजे ।
एतना कहा मोर प्रभु कीजे ॥
verses.tr:
janakasutā raghunāthahi dīje
etanā kahā mor prabhu kīje

verses.sa:
जब तेहिं कहा देन बैदेही ।
चरन प्रहार कीन्ह सठ तेही ॥
verses.tr:
jab tehiṃ kahā den baidehī
caran prahār kīnh saṭh tehī

verses.sa:
नाइ चरन सिरु चला सो तहाँ ।
कृपासिंधु रघुनायक जहाँ ॥
verses.tr:
nāi caran siru calā so tahām̐
kṛpāsiṃdhu raghunāyak jahām̐

verses.sa:
करि प्रनामु निज कथा सुनाई ।
राम कृपाँ आपनि गति पाई ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranāmu nij kathā sunāī
rām kṛpām̐ āpani gati pāī

verses.sa:
रिषि अगस्ति कीं साप भवानी ।
राछस भयउ रहा मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
riṣi agasti kīṃ sāp bhavānī
rāchas bhayau rahā muni gyānī

verses.sa:
बंदि राम पद बारहिं बारा ।
मुनि निज आश्रम कहुँ पगु धारा ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdi rām pad bārahiṃ bārā
muni nij āśram kahum̐ pagu dhārā

verses.sa:
बिनय न मानत जलधि जड़ गए तीन दिन बीति ।
बोले राम सकोप तब भय बिनु होइ न प्रीति ॥
verses.tr:
binaya na mānat jaladhi jar̤ gae tīn din bīti
bole rām sakop tab bhaya binu hoi na prīti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Ten-headed, as he listened, was terror-stricken at heart, but smiled with his lips and cried aloud for all to hear: ‘He who stretches out his hands to clutch the sky only falls to the ground: a devotee’s idle talk is of small account.” Said Saka: ‘“ My lord, every word is true; be

wise and abandon you. saiure: arrogance, Cease from wrath and hearken to my advice; make an end, Sire, of your fend with Rama. Raghubir is exceedingly mild in disposition, though he is the sovereign of all the world. The Lord will be gracious to you directly you approach him, and will not remember even one of your offences. Restore to him Janak’s daughter; this, Sire, is all I ask of you; do it.” When he spoke to him of giving up Sita, the wretch spurned him with his foot; but he bowed his head to the ground before him and then went to join the allmerciful Rama, and after due obeisance told him All that had happened. By Rama's grace, he recovered his proper rank; for it was by the Rishi Agastya curse, Bhavani, that he had become a demon, though still retaining the intelligence of a saint. Now, once more in the form of a saint, after again and again prostrating himself at Rama’s feet, he went his way to his own hermitage.
Dullard Ocean made no answer to prayer, though three days had been spent; then cried Rama in afury: ‘He will do me no kindness, unless he frightened.

sections.label: Doha 58
sections.name: काटेहिं पइ कदरी फरइ कोटि जतन कोउ सींच

verses.sa:
लछिमन बान सरासन आनू ।
सोषौं बारिधि बिसिख कृसानू ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman bān sarāsan ānū
soṣauṃ bāridhi bisikh kṛsānū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सठ सन बिनय कुटिल सन प्रीती ।
सहज कृपन सन सुंदर नीती ॥
verses.tr:
saṭh san binaya kuṭil san prītī
sahaj kṛpan san suṃdar nītī

verses.sa:
ममता रत सन ग्यान कहानी ।
अति लोभी सन बिरति बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
mamatā rat san gyān kahānī
ati lobhī san birati bakhānī

verses.sa:
क्रोधिहि सम कामिहि हरि कथा ।
ऊसर बीज बएँ फल जथा ॥
verses.tr:
krodhihi sam kāmihi hari kathā
ūsar bīj baem̐ phal jathā

verses.sa:
अस कहि रघुपति चाप चढ़ावा ।
यह मत लछिमन के मन भावा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi raghupati cāp car̤hāvā
yah mat lachiman ke man bhāvā

verses.sa:
संघानेउ प्रभु बिसिख कराला ।
उठी उदधि उर अंतर ज्वाला ॥
verses.tr:
saṃghāneu prabhu bisikh karālā
uṭhī udadhi ur aṃtar jvālā

verses.sa:
मकर उरग झष गन अकुलाने ।
जरत जंतु जलनिधि जब जाने ॥
verses.tr:
makar urag jhaṣ gan akulāne
jarat jaṃtu jalanidhi jab jāne

verses.sa:
कनक थार भरि मनि गन नाना ।
बिप्र रूप आयउ तजि माना ॥
verses.tr:
kanak thār bhari mani gan nānā
bipr rūp āyau taji mānā

verses.sa:
काटेहिं पइ कदरी फरइ कोटि जतन कोउ सींच ।
बिनय न मान खगेस सुनु डाटेहिं पइ नव नीच ॥
verses.tr:
kāṭehiṃ pai kadarī pharai koṭi jatan kou sīṃc
binaya na mān khages sunu ḍāṭehiṃ pai nav nīc
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Lakshman bring me my bow and arrows: with my fiery darts I will dry op the deep. To use entreaties toa charl, to lavish affection upon a rogue, to deal liberally with a born miser, to discourse of divine wisdom with a man devoted to self, to speak of detachment from the world to the covetous, to tell of Hari to a man under the influence of passion or love, in all the same as sowing the sand in hope of a harvest.” So saying, RAma strung his bow, a proceeding that pleased Lakshman mightily. The Lord let fly the terrible shaft; a burning pain ensued in the bosom of ocean; the crocodiles, serpents and fish were all sore distrest. When Ocean perceived that these creatures were burning, he filled a golden dish with all kinds of jewels and humbly presented himself in the form of a Brahman.

Though you may take infinite trouble in watering it, a plantain will not bear fruit, until ithas been well trimmed; similarly, mark me, Garur, a mean upstart heeds neither prayers nor compliments, but requires rougher treatment.

sections.label: Doha 59
sections.name: सुनत बिनीत बचन अति कह कृपाल मुसुकाइ

verses.sa:
सभय सिंधु गहि पद प्रभु केरे ।
छमहु नाथ सब अवगुन मेरे ॥
verses.tr:
sabhaya siṃdhu gahi pad prabhu kere
chamahu nāth sab avagun mere
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गगन समीर अनल जल धरनी ।
इन्ह कइ नाथ सहज जड़ करनी ॥
verses.tr:
gagan samīr anal jal dharanī
inh kai nāth sahaj jar̤ karanī

verses.sa:
तव प्रेरित मायाँ उपजाए ।
सृष्टि हेतु सब ग्रंथनि गाए ॥
verses.tr:
tav prerit māyām̐ upajāe
sṛṣṭi hetu sab graṃthani gāe

verses.sa:
प्रभु आयसु जेहि कहँ जस अहई ।
सो तेहि भाँति रहे सुख लहई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu āyasu jehi kaham̐ jas ahaī
so tehi bhām̐ti rahe sukh lahaī

verses.sa:
प्रभु भल कीन्ही मोहि सिख दीन्ही ।
मरजादा पुनि तुम्हरी कीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu bhal kīnhī mohi sikh dīnhī
marajādā puni tumharī kīnhī

verses.sa:
ढोल गवाँर सूद्र पसु नारी ।
सकल ताड़ना के अधिकारी ॥
verses.tr:
ḍhol gavām̐r sūdr pasu nārī
sakal tār̤anā ke adhikārī

verses.sa:
प्रभु प्रताप मैं जाब सुखाई ।
उतरिहि कटकु न मोरि बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pratāp maiṃ jāb sukhāī
utarihi kaṭaku na mori bar̤āī

verses.sa:
प्रभु अग्या अपेल श्रुति गाई ।
करौं सो बेगि जौ तुम्हहि सोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu agyā apel śruti gāī
karauṃ so begi jau tumhahi sohāī

verses.sa:
सुनत बिनीत बचन अति कह कृपाल मुसुकाइ ।
जेहि बिधि उतरै कपि कटकु तात सो कहहु उपाइ ॥
verses.tr:
sunat binīt bacan ati kah kṛpāl musukāi
jehi bidhi utarai kapi kaṭaku tāt so kahahu upāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Terrified Ocean clasped the Lord’s feet: Pardon me, Sire, all my offences. Air, wind, fire, water and earth are all, my lord, naturally dull and slow to change. They have been produced by the delusive power that you sent forth with a view to creation—so all the scriptures declare—and as each has been fixed by the Lord’s command, so it must remain, to secure its own happiness. My lord has done well in giving me this lesson; but still it was you who first fixed my bounds. A drum, a clown, a churl, a beast, and a woman are all fit subjects for beating. By my lord’s favor, I shall be dried up, the army will cross over, and my glory will be at an end; the scriptures declare the word of the Lord to be unchangeable; do then at once what seemeth you good.”
The Lord smiled to hear this exceedingly humble speech, and said, “Tell me, father, some device, how the monkey host may cross over?

sections.label: Doha 60
sections.name: सकल सुमंगल दायक रघुनायक गुन गान

verses.sa:
नाथ नील नल कपि द्वौ भाई ।
लरिकाई रिषि आसिष पाई ॥
verses.tr:
nāth nīl nal kapi dvau bhāī
larikāī riṣi āsiṣ pāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तिन्ह कें परस किए गिरि भारे ।
तरिहहिं जलधि प्रताप तुम्हारे ॥
verses.tr:
tinh keṃ paras kie giri bhāre
tarihahiṃ jaladhi pratāp tumhāre

verses.sa:
मैं पुनि उर धरि प्रभु प्रभुताई ।
करिहउँ बल अनुमान सहाई ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ puni ur dhari prabhu prabhutāī
karihaum̐ bal anumān sahāī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि नाथ पयोधि बँधाइअ ।
जेहिं यह सुजसु लोक तिहुँ गाइअ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi nāth payodhi bam̐dhāia
jehiṃ yah sujasu lok tihum̐ gāia

verses.sa:
एहिं सर मम उत्तर तट बासी ।
हतहु नाथ खल नर अघ रासी ॥
verses.tr:
ehiṃ sar mam uttar taṭ bāsī
hatahu nāth khal nar agh rāsī

verses.sa:
सुनि कृपाल सागर मन पीरा ।
तुरतहिं हरी राम रनधीरा ॥
verses.tr:
suni kṛpāl sāgar man pīrā
turatahiṃ harī rām ranadhīrā

verses.sa:
देखि राम बल पौरुष भारी ।
हरषि पयोनिधि भयउ सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām bal pauruṣ bhārī
haraṣi payonidhi bhayau sukhārī

verses.sa:
सकल चरित कहि प्रभुहि सुनावा ।
चरन बंदि पाथोधि सिधावा ॥
verses.tr:
sakal carit kahi prabhuhi sunāvā
caran baṃdi pāthodhi sidhāvā

verses.sa:
निज भवन गवनेउ सिंधु श्रीरघुपतिहि यह मत भायऊ ।
यह चरित कलि मल हर जथामति दास तुलसी गायऊ ॥
verses.tr:
nij bhavan gavaneu siṃdhu śrīraghupatihi yah mat bhāyaū
yah carit kali mal har jathāmati dās tulasī gāyaū
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सुख भवन संसय समन दवन बिषाद रघुपति गुन गना ।
तजि सकल आस भरोस गावहि सुनहि संतत सठ मना ॥
verses.tr:
sukh bhavan saṃsaya saman davan biṣād raghupati gun ganā
taji sakal ās bharos gāvahi sunahi saṃtat saṭh manā

verses.sa:
सकल सुमंगल दायक रघुनायक गुन गान ।
सादर सुनहिं ते तरहिं भव सिंधु बिना जलजान ॥
verses.tr:
sakal sumaṃgal dāyak raghunāyak gun gān
sādar sunahiṃ te tarahiṃ bhav siṃdhu binā jalajān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘My lord, there are two monkey brothers, Nila and Nala, who from childhood have been instructed by a sage. The mightiest mountains touched by them will by your favor float upon the waves. I too, remembering your majesty, will assist to the best of my power. In this manner, my lord, you will bridge the sea and the glorious deed will be sung in earth, heaven and hell. With this. arrow, Sire, slay the dwellers on my northern shore, who are vile criminals.” The All-merciful, on hearing Ocean’s grievance, at once removed it, the valiant Rama.' At the sight of his mighty vigour Ocean rejoiced and became easy of mind, and after telling him all that had taken place, bowed at his feet and took his leave.

Ocean returned home and Rama approved his counsel. These his acts, which remove all the impurities of this sinful age, has Tulsi Das sung to the best of his ability. The excellences of Raghupati are a treasure of delight, a panacea for all doubt, a purge for every sorrow, and they who are wise of heart will abandon all other hope and confidence and be ever singing them or hearing them sung.
The virtues of Raghu-neyak are the source of every blessing, and those who reverently hear their recital cross the ocean of existence without any need for a boat.
